༄ga /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga nye ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi dhi/ bod skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa'i dra ba mtha' dag rnam par bsal zhing dri med ye shes snang bas mdzes/ /sangs rgyas sku yi tshogs ni rtag tu sprul pas 'gro ba'i don ni phun tshogs mdzad/ /kun dga' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsal rig ma dam pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje 'dzin de btud nas 'dus pa'i gzhung du rab gnas cho ga bdag gis rab tu bshad/ /rab gnas mkha' dbyings mnyam nyid rjes 'brel ba/ /bde gshegs glegs bam rdo dril chos de bzhin/ /'jig rten don dam ma rtogs de yi phyir/ /'jig rten phan phyir mgon pos rab gnas mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags/ /stang stabs stan dang sbyin sreg bzlas/ /mchod pa'i las kyi sbyor ba dang / /bsdu ba zhes bya de nyid bcu/ /slob dpon 23—22

de nyid bcu shes shing / /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /bstan bcos kun gyi don la mkhas/ /bla ma las ni dbang kun thob/ /rjes su gnang ba'i yon tan can/ /brtan po dam tshig sdom par ldan/ /theg pa gsum gyi dgongs pa shes/ /sku gzugs mchod rten gtsug lag khang / /dam chos ras ris 1glegs bam rnams/ /bzang po tshad kyis mdzes pa dang / /sdogs pa bde ba'i rgyu rnams la/ /de shes mtshan nyid rtogs pa yis/ /rab gnas bya bar 'os pa ste/ /rjes su yi rang byed pa dang / /yon bdag bsod nams spel phyir ro/ /nam yang rab gnas dman pa ni/ /cho ga nyams pas mi bya ste/ /'jig rten 'di ru sdug bsngal che/ /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /de phyir dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad la yang nan tan bya/ /rtog pa las byung de bzhin du/ /rang nyid kyi ni nus pas bsgrub/ /de ltar byas na bsod nams che/ /mthong dang ma mthong skye bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags bzang pos lha rnams ni/ /bzhugs par 'gyur ba nyid yin no/ /gang du sgu gzugs zin pa ni/ /yun ring mchod pa ma byas bzhugs/ /yon bdag la ni mi shis 'byung / /ji srid rab gnas ma byas par/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rigs dang mtshan nyid bral ba la/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod bya min/ /de bzhin du yang gzugs brnyan no/ /gang zhig rab gnas ma byas la/ /phyag dang mchod pa gang zhig dang / /gsang sngags dman pas bsreg rdzas bzhin/ /'bras med sbyin sreg thal bar zad/ /de bzhin gsang sngags med par ni/ /chos gnas mchod pa byed pa yang / /las de yi ni rnam smin gyis/ /skye ba kun du mi mchod 'gyur/ /23—23

de la thog ma nyid du 1rang nyid bsod nams 'dod pas sam/ slob mas gsol ba btab pas rab gnas rtsol ba na 1sna/ re zhig sngon du bsnyen pa bya ste/de la ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags dang rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sngags 'bum du bzlas par bya'o/ /gzhan dag gi sngags khri bzla bar bya'o/ /yang na bdag po'i bkas sam lhag par mos pas rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon du song bas lan gnyis sam gsum mchog tu gsol ba btab pa de'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis yo byad 'tshogs sam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /de na re cung zad ni 'tshogs la cung zad ni snyem 'tshogs so zhes zer na/ de'i tshe 4yang slob ma'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig chogi 'od zer rnams kyis 6snying gar gnas pa rka yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba nag po'i 7rnam par gyur pa'i 8me+eg pa 'phyang ba sha za lta bu'i sdig pa sna'i rtse mor 'thon pa dang / yi ge hūṃ de yang snying gar 'thon pas g.yon brkyang ba mche ba gcigs pa gsus pa 'phyang 9ba sku mdog nag po phyag g.yon snying gar sdigs mdzub dang mche ba can/ phyag g.yas mche ba gdengs pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin khro ba'i gzugs can du byas nas 'thon pas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā da khā da pā 11pa n+ya su hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas sdig pa 'di zar bcug nas slob ma de yang saṃ yig las kun du bzang po'i gzugs su rnam par bsams te/ de'i sems kyi bgegs rnams bdud rtsi 'khyil pas phur bus btab ste phur bu'i 'od zer shin tu drag pa 'jigs pa rnams kyis gdug pa thams cad nges par bsregs nas/slob ma'i snying gar bsrung ba'i don du yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la dbyangs tha ma pa ⑪las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par / bsam 23—24

par bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas stegs bu rnying pa'am/ mchod rten gyi gzhi'am lha'i rigs kyi khang pa la sogs pa yongs su brtags pa'i sa gzhi yod par phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyis sbyang ba dang gzung ba dang / phur bus gdab pa dang / rdo rje gur dang ra ba dang / phyogs bcing ba dang /mtshams bcing ba dang / lhag par gnas pa dang thig gdab pa dang rdul tshon dgye ba la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa las bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas yongs su brtags shing shin tu 'jam pa'i sa phyogs su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mdun du bsang gtor la sogs pa'i snod bzhag nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byas te/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bum pa rnams lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de la rtsa ba dang nag bo med pa mchu 'phyang ba mgrin pa ring ba lto ba che 1ba nas dang gro dang ma sha dang 'bras so ba dang til rnams te 'bru lnga dang / thra haste 2dang kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang a pa ra dzi ta dkar po dang ha sa dang ④ha sa de ba rnams te sman lnga dang / gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang byi ru dang mu men rnams te rin po che lnga dang / gur gum dang gla rtsi dang si h+la dang tsan+dan dang ga bur rnams te dri lnga dang ldan pa/bste gnas kyi chus gang ba/ 'dzam bu dang ka piza dang ma du lung ga dang shrī pa la ste yal ga lngas kha brgyan pa/ gos sar pa zung gis mgul pa dkris pa/chos 'byung la gnas pa'i rang gi lha'i mtshan mas mtshan pa la yi ge baṃ las rin po che'i rang bzhin las byas par bsams nas gdugs dang bcas pa rjes su mthun pa'i gdan la bzhag pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum par 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo bsgoms nas me tog gi phreng bas dkris pa'i rdo rje 23—25

bum pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i phreng ba'i rtse mo nas bzung ste/ yi ge gsum dang spel ba'i rang gi lha'i sngags kyis a dhi tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba des brgya rtsa brgyad du de la mngon par bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas ar+gha la sogs pa phul te mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ dril bu dkrol bzhin pas mngon par bstod par bya'o/ /de nas gzhan yang dkyil 'khor pa'i bum pa rnams 1ni cung zad chung ba rjes su mthun pa'i gdan la bzhag pa rnams la dri'i chu yis bkang ste/ 'dzam bu dang tsu ta la sogs pa'i yal gas kha brgyan pa sman lnga la sogs pa dang ldan pa mgrin pa gos kyis dkris pa rang gi lha'i mtshan ma 2gdugs dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha bsgoms pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ dkyil 'khor pa'i sngags yi ge gsum dang spel bas tha mar a bye tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba dang / lan bdun bdun bzla bar bya'o/ /'gro ba kun bsang 4ba'i don du bum pa gzhan du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bsgoms nas/ oṃ a bispyo ta kṛta hūṃ abye 5tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzla bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du ar+gha 6la sogs pa phul nas yang dag par mchod de/ bstod pa bya'o / /bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don du phyogs skyong rnams la de'i sngags kyis gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de la 'di ltar bum pa lhag par gnas pa nyi ma re re zhing thun gsum 7gsum du bya'o/ /bum pa mdor bsdu ba'i phyogs la ni rigs kyi yum bzhi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang rang gi rigs dang bcas pa lnga dang / las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang bcur brtag par bya'o / /rdul tshon dgye ba bum pa dgod par bya'o/ /de la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni gtso bo'i g.yas phyogs su'am dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol du gzhag par 23—26

bya'o / /dkyil 'khor pa'i bum pa rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi zur bzhir dgod par bya'o/ /las thams cad pa'i bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i rtsa ba'i sgo'i g.yas phyogs su gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa de rnams las chu nyung zad nyung zad blangs te bdud rtsi lnga'i snod du blugs nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi sa gzhi nye bar byugs par gyen du bsgreng ba'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang / bla re phub pa'i mtha' ma rnams nas rnga yab dkar po dbe+engs te/ dri zhim po'i me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram nas dum bu dang bsdus pa la sogs pa'i spos dud gtul te/ si h+la dang / ga pur dang /gur gum dang / gla rtsi dang / tsan+dan dang 'dres pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pas chag chag btab pa'i sa'i char pi wang dang / gling bu dang rnga zlum dal ba dang / glu dang gar gyi dga' ston dang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan cing bum pa gang bas brgyan pa'i gnas su gza' dang rgyu skar dang / dus sbyor bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin zhag bzang po la khrus dang gtsang sbra byas te gos dang rgyan bzang po dbu rgyan me tog dang bcas pas grogs bzang bo dang lag pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas stan thog mthon po 'jam pa la 'dug ste/ mdun du bsang gtor la sogs pa'i snod bzhag nas dkyil 'khor mchod de ting 'dzin gsum dang ldan pa'i sngags pas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs las gsungs pa bzhin dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas mngon du phyogs pa'i lha rnams kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa—/ rjes su mthun pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang gdan la snyoms par 23—27

zhugs pa/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyis thugs kar byin gyis brlabs pa/ rigs dang mthun pa'i cod pan gyi 1lha rnams skad cig mas bltas la/ nam mkha' la yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdor bsdus pa'i gzugs dkyil 'khor pas yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po mngon par bltas la bsang gtor la sogs pa phul te/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma 2la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis shusna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod nas bstod pa byas te bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de nas dri zhim po'i me tog gi snyim pas lus btud de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ra ma su khā ④sha ya su la li ta5/ bi lā se nā mi taidrwa mā 4mi bha ga wādhe dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥpra tīts+tsha ku su ma añdza li nā tha ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas snyim dzo pa'i me tog dor bar bya'o/ /de nas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas pas spos dud bskyod pas bdag po de dag gzhan dag kyang snyan gsan dbab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje che ge mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mgon po bdag ni rab gnas dag /dgyid par 'tshal gyi thugs rje can/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan gus pa bdag la ni/ /rjes su gzung bar rngumadzad pa'i rigs/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad dag /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa las7/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhum gshegs ltar/ /de bzhin gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /'dir ni rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang / /me tog la sogs mchod pa rnams/ /byang chub sems ni 'phel ba'i phyir/ /che ge'i don du bzhes su gsol / /'go 23—28

ba'i 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po sangs rgyas bstan gnas dang / /bstan la mngon dga'i sems can rnams/ /gang zhig rdo rje'i mig can yang / /rdo rje can bdag che ge mo/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /nye bar spyod pa ci nus kyis/ /'gro ba dag snaphyir bgyid par 'tshal/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /slob ma dang bcas bdag la ni/ /'di dag lhan cig thams cad kyis/ /nye ba nyid du mdzad pa'i rigs/ /de ltar lan gsum du snyan gsan phab nas snga ma bzhin yang dag par mchod de bstod nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de ltar lha snyan gsan dbab pa byas nas bdag nyid gzengs bstod par bya ste/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gis mnyam par/ /gyur par bdag ni the tshom sna med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skyes par the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med//sangs rgyas thams cad snyan mnan pas/ /di ring bdag ni nye bar gyur/ /de'i rjes la slob dpon gyis sgrub grogs yod na dkyil 'khor gyi sar bzhag la phyi rol du byung ste/ bdag po'am khro bo'i rnal 'byor gyis bza' btung dang nya sha dang 'bras mar gyi spod snyedang til dang snum khur zlum po la sogs pa'i gtor ma man ngag ji lta ba bzhin sbyangs te/ gnas ji lta ba bzhin du dbang po la sogs pa bkug nas so so'i phyogs kyi sgo nyid du bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil la 23——29

sogs pa byin nas me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod de khur kyis sam/snyim pas lan gsum du sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas zhal bsil la sogs pa phul te yang dag par mchod nas slar gtang bar bya'o/ /de nas nang du zhugs te bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i 1bzlas pa'i skud pa sum dkris rīsu mdud pa gsum gyis dpung pa g.yas par bcings te/ las thams cad pa'i chus g.yas g.yon du bsangs te slob ma bsrung ba'o/ /phrin las 'di dag thams cad legs par —bsgul ba byas pa'i slob ma dang lhan cig spyad par bya'o/ /de dag la yang 'di bsgo bar bya ste/ gsang sngags gang cung zad cig smra/ /mchod sogs cho ga de bya ste/ /mchod sbyin 'bras bu che 'byung la/ /sgyu yis bya ba ma yin nyid/ /de nas bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ji srid 'dod par bzlas te nyal bar bya'o/ /'di ni lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas phyi de nyin par tho rangs kyi dus su ji skad bstan pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid dang /yo byad thams cad 'tshogs pa'i sngags pas zhi ba'i gtor ma btang nas lha la mngon du phyogs te lha'i rnal 'byor byas pas sku gzugs zhal shar du gzigs pa na bza' ser pos 4dkris pa la sngar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid can du rnal 'byor gyis bskyed pa'i rnam pa 5thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i snying ga dang / spyi bo dang / gog mar hūṃ oṃ u/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa stegs bu'i steng du 'dug stan gtsang ma la bzhag nas dri ma sel ba rnams kyis dri ma bsal bar bya'o/ /de la khu tshur g.yas g.yon gyis bzung ba'i yungs kar dang chu dang zan lugs su 'byung ba dang / lugs las bzlog pas bskor zhing oṃ sarba 6pā paṃ da ha na badzā 7ya swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lan gsum mer blugs 23—30

par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ zhes bya ba lan bdun du bzlas pa'i dri zhim po'i mar khus ku sha'i tshom bu bzang po byugs nas khar ba'i snod du bzhag pa'i pa ṭa dang u dusmra nyar dang / a shwaza dang /shri buṣa dang / blag sha'i shun pa brdungs pas brud nas sa bon lngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang 'dres pa'i ba'i lcernam lngas bkru bar bya'o/ /phyi nas rgyal po dbang bskur ④ba'i gdugs dkar po 'dzin pa'i mi dang bcas pas rgyal ba dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis bstod bzhin pa dang /tur+ya'i glusgra dang bud med rnams kyi ca co'i sgra rnams dang / nye bar mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho gas spyan la sogs pa'i phyag gis bzung ba'i bum pa treye shes kyi chus gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur bar lhag par mos pas khrus kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod bzhin pas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de la khrus kyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol pa/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ye shrī hūṃ/ po ti dang thang sku la sogs pa rnams la rgo lhag par mos pas me long la khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de la dbang bskur ⑦ba'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ dang po ni rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pas so/ /de nas rnam snang la sogs pa'i bum pas so/ /de nas rgo spyan la sogs pa'i bum pas so/ /de nas rgo gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa'i bum pas so/ /de nas ni sa'i snying po la sogs pa'i bum pas so/ /de nas ni gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i bum pas so/ /de'i tshe yang bkra shis kyi glu blang bar bya'o/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bkra shis gang zhig rgyal ba rnams kyi chos 23—31

kyi sgu/ /gcig nyid dang ni du ma nyid kyang rnam spangs pa'i/ /ma gos gzugs med rdul dang bral ba gang yin pa'i/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig sangs rgyas sras kyis yongs bskor zhing 1 //longs spyod rdzogs sku dam chos kyi ni gsungs bye snadang bcas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos yongs su brgyan gyur pa/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig nags kyi me ni mched pa ltar/ /'jug dang 'bar dang yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog gzhan gyi don ni mdzad pa'o/ /bkra shis de yis khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnam dag bye blo ldan nyes pa'i tshogs dang bral/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pas mdzes pa'i bde ba'i bdag /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la ni dbang mchog bskur / /bkra shis gang zhig lha dang lha min mis mchod pa/ /de yis bstan pa'i dam chos bla na med pa ni/ /bdag med 'jig rten gsum las rab tu grags pa yi/ /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la yang dbang mchog bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig rab mchog dam chos rtag tu 'dzin/ /bzang po'i sar bzhugs sangs rgyas sras po'i tshogs kyi mchog /rnam pa kun du sems can don mdzad bkra shis bzang / /bkra shis de yis khyed rnams la ni dbang mchog bsgur/ /de ltar rim pa bzhin du khrus gsol nas/ de nas gos dkar po srab mos phyis te gur kum gyi lde byegus byugs pa la na bza' dkar po zung gcig /oṃ di bya bā sa se swā hā/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis yongs su gsol bar bya'o/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra gadhe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis ga bur dang gla rtsi dang gur gum la sogs pa'i dri rnams kyis 23—32

mnyam par byugs nas gal te yod na/ oṃ badz+ra ā ba 1ra ṇa bi bhu ṣa ṇi swā hā/zhes bya bas spyan dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas go ro tsa na'i thig le byas te me tog dang bdug spos dang / mar me tasbo la yang phul nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis kun du bsrungs te/ dkyil 'khor la yang hūṃ yig gis bteg nas ṭak+ki'i sngags la a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbus su gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas yod na phyi rol gyi rig ma de med na bsgom pa dang lhan cig bsam gtan gyis gnas te/ pad+ma dang rdo rje'i sgras bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi snying gar bcug nas zhu bar byas te rang gi rdo rje go cha'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+ma'i nang du lhung bar gyur pa dang /shes rab kyi ba sru'i bu ga rnams nas 'od zer du gyur nas 'thon pa dang /nam mkha' khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par blos nye bar bzhag ste/bsang gtor dang zhal bsel la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'phags pa gshin rje gshed la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis de dang lhan cig gnas pa'i bgegs kyi rigs bkug bskrad nas de rnams nyid dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas dgug pa dang / shin tu nges par rdzogs pa de la rab tu 4gzhug cing bcings te dbang du byas te spyan dang sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ dbang bskur ba yang byas nas bsang gtor la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dbul bar bya ste/chu dang de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /bdag gis gus pas phul bas na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis me tog dbul bar bya'o/ /lhan skyes de bzhin sbyar ba yi//23—33

bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu gus pas rab tu 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra 1dhū pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis spos so/ /lhan skyes de bzhin sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag nyid/ /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul gyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ a badz+ra gadhe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis 2dri'o/ /lha rdzas 'bar ba mun pa 'joms / /snum ldan sgron ma 'di dag ni/ /rab tu dang bas 'bul lags na / /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis sgron ma'o/ /zhal zas rnam kun yang dag ldan/ /bza' dang ston mor bcas pa 'di/ /kha dog ro dang drir ldan pa/ /dbul lo yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ a badz+ra nai bi t+ya 4hūṃ zhes bya bas lha bshos so/ /de nas zhal bsil phul 5te/ me tog gis mchod nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis bstod nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te lus btud nas sngags pa mnyam par gzhag pas de kho na nyid kyi bden pa bdar bar bya'o/ /nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje che ger bdag grub mdzod/ /dkon 6mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod 7nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs / /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' 23—34

bdag grub mdzod/ /dkon 1mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug che mchog phyag rgya yis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pas/ /rdo rje snying po bdag por bdag /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas—/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid kyang / /dam tshig rtse mo 'dod pa'i mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor na/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag po/ /'dod pa yongs su grub par shog /ces bya ba'o/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa lan bdun du bzlas pa bya ste/oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha ba/su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ zhes bya ba'o/ /de ltar brtan par byas nas sems can don du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /mgon po skal ba de bzhin du/ /des ni 'go don kun du mdzod/ /sda tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /zhes so/ /de nas phyi rol du byung ste gtor ma btang nas pad+ma'i snod kyi bdud rtsis tshim par byas nas yang dag par —mchod de/ phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i slob dpon nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ cho ga ma tshang ba bskang ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ste/ de la dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su 'dug ste byang du mngon par phyogs pa'i sngags pa ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan pas sbyin sreg gi rab tu byed pa nas bshad pa'i cho 23—35

ga las thams cad pa'i thab khung du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi tha mar slob ma'i shezhi rgyas 'phel bar bya ba'i don du mthe bong lag pa g.yas pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ bsreg rdzas re re zhing lan gsum mam bdun bdun bsreg gam bsreg tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma las yon blang she bar bya ste/ slob mas kyang dga' ba'i yid kyis rang gi 'byor pa dang mthun pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bu mo dang / rta dang glang po dang shing rta dang ba lang dang ma he la sogs pa rnams dang gser dang dngul dang zangs dang nor bu dang mu tig la sogs pa'i nor rdzas dang / lo tog yongs su rgyas pa'i zhing sa dang / khyim dang kun dga' ra ba dang / ldum ra la sogs pa'i gnas dang / bran pho dang / bran mo la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams mngon par 'dod pa'i dgos pa 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /slob dpon mnyes pas lha rnams mnyes/ /mnyes pas dngos grub rab sprul 'gyur/ /zhes shes par byas la/ rnam pa thams cad du bla ma mnyes par bya'o/ /gal te yod na rgyal po dang sa bdag dang / dge 'dun dang / phyogs skyong dang / bdag nyid kyi'ang zhi rgyas 'phel bar bya ba'i don de bzhin sreg blugs dbul bar bya'o/ /tha mar dgang blugs phul nas zhal bsil la sogs pa drangs te mkhyen par gsol te/ bzod pa gsol ba byas nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas zangs su legs par bkrus pa sbyin sreg gi lhag ma'i sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang bu ram dang ka ra la sogs pa bsres pa'i thug pa rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i sngags kyis legs par bsgrubs nas/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du drugs te/oṃ dī be an+de sa mā dhi dh+yā na t+pā na ni 5swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis yongs su 23—36

bzlas te/ lha rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dri gtsang khang la sogs pa'i gnas su legs par bslabs pa'i bzo bos byas pa sku sum cha'i tshad kyi gdan khri la steng dang 'og tu gzigs pa ma yin par drang bor legs par brtan par byas te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /ma yin na nyes pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snga ma bsang 1gtor la sogs pa phul te yang dag par 2mchod nas bstod de bdud rtsi myang ba byas la yi ge brgya pa'i sngags lan bdun bzlas te mkhyen par gsol te bzod gsol bya'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras lha/ /gang zhig tshangs sogs lha yi ni/ /tshogs rnams lha yi bya ba la/ /ma tshang ba ni bzod mdzad rigs/ /kun du zhi dang bde legs dang / /yon bdag don ched mdzad nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /bskal pa brgya ni brgya yi bar/ /gang gi sku gzugs 'di bzhugs pa4/ /sa chu me dang rlung gi lha/ /thams cad kyis ni srung bar mdzod/ /rang gnas bde debar gshegs nas ni/ /shin tu dga' gcugs yid kyis ni/ /slob dpon slob mar yang dag ldan/ /bu dang bu mor bcas pa srungs/ /khyad par brjod par bya ste/ bris pa dang brtsigs pa rnams la yang ji skad bshad pa'i tshogs rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /de la ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnal 'byor ram / rab tu gnas par bya ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis so/ /rje btsun gyi mchod rten la ni dri gtsang khang bskyed pa'i cho gas bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi pho brang du bsgoms nas/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang rig pa dang gsang sngags kyi lha ma lus pa 23—37

bkug nas mchod rten gyi nang du rab tu gzhug cing / bcings te dbang du byas nas bsang gtor dang / ar+gha dang zhabs bsil dang dbang bskur dang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas bdud rtsi myang ba byas te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā1/ oṃ hūṃ hri rgyu tre ṭasba zhes pa'i sngags kyis rab tu gnas par bya'o / /lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa ni 'di ltar rab tu gnas par bya ste/ yi ge bye yongs su gyur pa las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser kyi mdog can/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa phyag bar ma gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis ni mchog sbyin dang po ti bsnams par bsgoms nas/ de yongs su gyur pa'i yi ge'i tshogs rnams kyis dkrigs par glegs bam rnam par bsgoms nas/ oṃ pradz+nyā shu ti smṛ ti ma ti bi dzā choya swā hā/ t+t+waṃ zhes bya bas rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi glegs bam la ni 'od dpag med yi ge'i gzugs su gyur par blta ste rab tu gnas par bya'o / /yang na gsang sngags kyi po ti bzhin du dam ngachos kyi glegs bam rab tu gnas par byas te/ 'od dpag med kyi rnal 'byor dang sngar bstan pa'i sngags kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'chang rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par rnam par bsgoms te 'di thams cad du'o/ /lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gtsug lag khang yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi pho brang ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas chos kyi dbyings rgya che bar yid kyis bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hūṃ s+thā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa byas te gtor ma 6mchod 23—38

pa'i nye bar spyod pa la sogs pa phul nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ tweḥ hūṃ khaṃ badz+rī bha ba dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha rja 1khaṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rab tu gnas nas/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa rnams kyis byin kyis brlabs pa rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa shin tu brtan par bsgoms nas bum pa thams cad kyi chus gtsug lag khang thams cad du bsang gtor byas te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de nas gtsug lag khang gi srung ma nag po chen po sgrub pa'i thabs nas bshad pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid can yid kyis bkug ste/ ro gcig tu gzhug cing bcings te dbang du byas nas slob dpon rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bka' bsgo bar bya ste gtsug lag khang 'di ji srid gnas par khyod kyis bsrung bar bya ste/ sdig pa med pa'i las rnams bya zhing slob dpon dang dge 'dun gyi bya ba thams cad la mchog tu brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar byas nas bla mas slob ma bos te/ gus pa dang bcas pas yang dag par smra bar bya ste/ gang khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rab gnas sdig pa 'joms pa de kho bos byas kyi4/ ji ltar bde bar nan tan gyis mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyis sbyangs pa'i tsā 5ru de la byin nas 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhag ma sdig pa 'joms pa ste zo cig ces so/ /gzhan dag la yang ji ltar thob par nyung ngu nyung ngu sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas yang yon blang ste—/ slob mas kyang yon dbul bas bla ma mnyes par byas nas/ mchod pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyis lha rnams mchod de bskor ba lan gsum byas te phyag bya'o//de nas rang gi gnas su song ste dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dzidage bsnyen ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la ston mo drangs nas yon phul 23—39

te bzod pa gsol nas slar gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas bzo bo rnams la ston mo byin te gos dang rgyan la sogs pa rnams kyis yongs su mgu bar byas nas slob dpon gyi rjes su 'brangs pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi yang 'khor rnams gos la sogs pa sbyin pas yongs su mgu bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang nad pa dang mgon med pa rnams kyang nus pa ji lta ba bzhin du mgu bar bya'o/ /mtshan mo nye du dang 'khor rnams la dga' ston chen po sbyin par bya ste/ be+e wang dang gling bu dang / rnga zlum dang rnga zlum dal 1ba la sogs pa'i sgra'i rjes su 'jug pa'i glu dang / glu dang rjes su mthun pa'i gar gyis skye bo mngon par dga' ba'i bkra shis dang bstod pa rnams kyis bza' ba dang ston mo dang bldag pa dang /btung ba dang / gzhib pa rnams dang / gos kyi gtam gyis kyang ste nus pa bzhin bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon dga' ston basbu ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sar bzhugs te yang dag par mchod nas bstod de/ yi ge gsum dang muḥ'i 4 mtha' can gyis bsdus nas rdul tshon sgod gsar par 5blugs te/ don du gnyer ba la 6nyung ngu byin nas chu bor dor bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa 3gzhi yang / oṃ a kā 8ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ā r+yanut+pan+da tā da muḥ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis ba'i lco ba byug 7par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma spyin no/ /rab gnas 'di 'dra byas na ni/ /skye ba 'di dang gzhan du yang / /mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob/ /de bas rtag tu 'di nyid bya/ /sa dong 'gengs dang rab gnas dang / /sbyin sreg 'khor lo'i yo byad gang / /de kun slob dpon nyid dbang zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gis gsungs/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mchog /'dus pa'i tshul du byas pa 23—40

las shesna—/ /bsod nams bdag skyes gang cung zad/ /des ni 'gro kun rdor 'dzin shog /bye bherab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon snang byed zla bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ba ren+d+ra pa'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba dge slong pradz+nyā krirtis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/22 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉g.ya/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba slob dngo/na snang byed la bas mdzad pa bzhugs so// — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdor/3〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thalta/23 7sna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉(6sa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rings/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reg24 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas sprul ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rini/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tshe/5〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉giyig 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉she / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tongagyur ba'i/shesna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skarachang / 〉〈〈snar 〉rnamathon/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipā/ 15〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa/ 12〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/25 shesna〈〈snar 〉〉phye/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā ha ti/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ha sa dang /26 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ram pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gim/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa/'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazang /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyita hūṃ a/ ce〈〈pe 〉zosargo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉mosarga/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigasum / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag ('di'i 'og gi gzhag par bya'o zhes pa'i gzhag rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal bzhag ces 'khod kyang bsdur mchar du bkod med/)28 she〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉〉sa/ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gim/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sta ta/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra mi ter na ma/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)nga / 8sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra byid/rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung ba/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉la/29 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga dag 5〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/ 〈〈snar 〉〉byem/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesas/3༷ she7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasum bkris/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo/23—41
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (734)23wa 43

0808༄7/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /bde ba che la rab btud nas/ /bdag 'dra'i blo dman nyid la ni/ /rab gnas cho ga bshad par bya/ /rtsa ba'i yan lag rab gnas la/ /phal cher khrus su 'dod pas na/ /bum pa'i nang du cho ga yis/ /blo dang ldan pas chu bskyed bya/ /mi nag zhabs med mchu 'phyang ba/ /lnga dang bcu dang bcu dgu'o/ /lnga po'i rim pa 'di yin te/ /gsang ba 'dus par mngon gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras sogs rnams/ /de rnams phyag mtshan shes par bya/ /de las gzhan pa'i rigs 'di yin/ /sa gnon dang ni byang chub mchog /mchog sbyin bsam gtan skyabs sbyin rnams/ /mi bskyod rtag pa 2rin chen dang / /dpag med don yod grub rnams kyi'o/ /23—47/

sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos bshad rgya she/ /byang chub mchog gis bsdus gyur pa'o/ /des na rdo rje gdan sogs kyis/ /mi bskyod sogs kyi rang bzhin no/ /thams cad kyis bhe ni po ti bsnams/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i bdag nyid gsal/ /rdo rje chos su rtag tu bya/ /de la sogs pa'i tshig gis kyang / /mchod rten gtsang khang byur bu dang / /mchod rten gyi ni bye brag rnams/ /rtag pa yi ni bdag nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs gang / /bya ba'i rgyud la sogs dang mthun/ /'dus pa las gsungs de nyid kyi/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis yang dag bzung / /sgyu 'phrul dra sogs bltas nas ni/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi rigs kyi rim/ /'dus pa'i cho gar bya ba ste/ /slar yang mi shes pa yi rigs/ /rdo rje thugs kyis bzung nas ni/ /phyag mtshan nyid ni yang dag bri/ /gtso bo'i mgrin par bri bar bya/ /logs su bde gshegs bzhi phyag mtshan/ /gcig la cho ga'i rim pas so/ /rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag mtshan ni/ /drug po cig car de bzhin gcig /khro bo gsum brtags bgegs dgra gcig /bcu yi phyogs la lha mo bzhi/ /de bzhin phyag mtshan re re la'o / /khro bo rnams kyang so sor ro/ /lhag ma rnams ni sngar bzhin bri/ /slar yang bcu dgu'i phyogs la ni/ /grangs ni ji bzhin bri bar bya/ /slar yang kha cig nyi shur 'dod/ /las kun byed pa bsnan pas so/ /me tog dri zhim ldan pa dang / /mgrin pa gos kyis dkris pa dang / /cung zad chu ldan a mrar ldan/ /go rims ji bzhin rnam par gzhag sna /g.yon du a mra la sogs dgod/ /'dug nas gtor ma yang dag sbyin/ /mu tig dngul dang gser zhes grags/ /mu men dang ni byi ru rnams / / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri daṇ+ḍid nyid/ /bṛ haste dang kaṇi 4ka /nas dang gro dang so ba dang / /til dang sran gre'u mngon par brjod/ /'bru lnga dang ni sman lnga dang / /23—45

rin chen 'di rnams kyis khengs pa/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs kyis ni/ /chu dang ldan par bskyed nas ni/ /kun du nyung ba'i chu blugs nas/ /kham phor rnam rgyal zhes brjod la/ /de ni baṃ las byung ba yi/ /rin chen rang bzhin bum steng gzhag hūṃ /rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan gyis bskyed pa'i/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bkug nas ni/ /zhabs bsil la sogs rim bzhin no/ /dam tshig dang ni lhan cig tu/ /byas nas mnyes bya mchod pa'o/ /me tog spos sogs phyi yis kyang / /rab tu 'bad de yang dag mchod/ /dril bu dkrol bya de yi ni/ /bstod pa byas te bzlas pa bya/ /gcig tu g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcings — —/ /rdo rje me tog gis bcings nas/ /bum pa chu yis gang ba ni ༄ / /kham phor steng du brtan par gzhag4 /de nas mchod cing phyag byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin nyid/ /chu yi rang bzhin nyid kyis gzhags /yang na bum pa la gzhug 6bya/ /de ltar 'di dang gzhan rnams kyi/ /thams cad so sor byas nas ni/ /me tog spos sogs sbyin byas nas/ /gtor ma sngon 'akro yang dag bsrung / /'di ni bum pa sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /lhag pa'i lha yi spyor ba las/ /don grub chu dang zan rnams kyis/ /lha rnams rdul ni bral bar bya/ /ba yi rnam lnga shing shun lngas/ /byugs te khrus bya mngon bzlas la/ /dri zhim gtsang ma'i chu yis ni/ /bkru bar rung ba rang gzugs kyis / /ri mo la sogs me long la/ /gang du las la sngags med pa/ /bgegs dgra de ru sbyar bar bya/ /mar nag dri zhim gyis byugs 3la/ /skyu ru ra yis bkru bar bya/ /ba yi rnam lnga sogs kyis byug /mar nag gis ni byugs pa gang / /bkru 23—46

bya sgyu ru ra yis kyang / /drur rmyeba'i chun po de 'dod do/ /chu yis bkru bar bya ba ste / /yang na bsgrubs pa'i chu yis kyang / /de la 'di ni mar nag gi sngags te/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ ras 'jam po yis dbyi bar bya/ /ji ltar nus pas gos sogs sbyin/ /ye shes sems dpa'i snying 'od kyis/ /lha rnams bkug nas bzhugs par bya/ /sangs rgyas dang gzhan de yi sras/ /bstan pa la ni dga' rnams la'ang rngo / /ku sha'i chun pos bsang gtor bya/ /zhabs bsil sogs kyis de rnams mchod/ /mchod sogs byas nas de rnams la/ /pus mo btsugs te yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje dril bu g.yon du 'dzin/ /spos phor g.yas su gzung bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje khyod/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod / /bcom ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /bdag ni rab gnas bgyi bar 'tshal—/ /slob ma la ni brtse don dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i ched/ /sems can bsod nams 'phel don dang / /byang chub sems ni spel don du/ /bcom ldan bdag la thugs brtse bas/ /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub sems sogs rang bzhin rnams / /bstan la mngon par dga' ba gzhan/ /gang dag rdo rje'i mig can rnams—/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /rab gnas che ge mo 'di yang / /bdag gis bgyi bas khyed rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlab 4ni bgyi bar rigs/ /ting 'dzin gsum dang ldan pa yis/ /lugs sku la sogs bskyed par bya/ /'dab ma dang bcas chu yis ni/ /mnyam par bzhag 4pas khrus byas nas/ /mchod pa sngon 'gro de yis ni/ /sngags kyis mngon par bsngags par 6bya/ /phyag byas mchod pa sogs byas nas/ /slar yang nye bar spyod pa lnga/ /nang par byon par 23—47

bzhed pa yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /'di ni lha sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /nang par sta gon bya ba la/ /rdul bral la sogs byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs sngar bkug nas/ /zhabs bsil byas te mchod par bya/ /spos phor bzung nas pus btsugs te/ /tshigs bcad sngon gsungs brjod par bya/ /bgyi ba'i tshig ni bor nas ni/ /bkyid par 'tshal zhes brjod par bya/ /ting 'dzin gsum la sbyar byas nas/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bsam par bya/ /bum pas khrus bya mang po yis/ /bkra shis sgra ni sngon 'gro bas/ /de la 'di ni khrus kyi sngags te/ji ltar bltams 1ma thag tu ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha rdzas chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta 27sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ gos sogs rang rang sngags kyis ni/ /mnyam par bzhag snapas brtan par bya/ /yang na rang gi sngags kyis sbyin/ /lhag par bzlas nas gtso la 'dud/ /de la 'di rnams ni rang rang gi sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra bā sa se swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye 4hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sarba ā ba ra 5ṇa bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ snod ni gser gyi rang bzhin nam/ /dngul gyi rang bzhin mnyam bzhag pas/ /bgegs dgra'i sngags kyis yang dag bsgrub / /mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs pa yidz+wa/ /gser kyi thur mas mig dbye ste/ /yang na bsam gtan dag gis bya/ /sbyin sreg mes bsgrubs zas kyis ni/ /de ma thag tu gsol bar bya/ /de la 'di ni mig gnyis dbye ba'i sngags te / oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsuk+ṣu 9bi sho dha swā hā/ oṃ dī pe arje sa mā dhidh+yā na dz+rī na 23—48

ni swā hā/ 'di ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan gnas su rab bzhugs nas/ /lha mo sgyu ma'i lhams zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bzhugs su gsol/ /mgon po rtag tu 'dir bzhugs la/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes mdzod / /che ge mo yi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub sems ni 'phel bar mdzod/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ smad dang snying ga mgrin pa ru/ /rdo rje gsor bas de rnams la / /lan gsum bskor nas gzhag par bya/ /lha rnams brtan par 'dod pa yis/ /'chad par 'dod pas tshigs bcad gdon/ /blo gros brtan pas bsam par bya/ /ma tshang lhag pa'i cho ga rnams/ /pus mo btsugs nas bzod par gsol/ /'di ni rab gnas kyi cho ga'o// //de la 'di ni sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste/ g.yon du me tog dkar po dang / /ldan pa'i dung sogs chu dang ldan/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yi bzlas/ /yang na bgegs kyi dgra yi sngags/ /las kun byed pa bzlas nas kyang / /ku sha'i chun po ldan pa yis/ /snod ni de ru gzhag par bya/ /bsang gtor la sogs dgos don du/ /yon chab la sogs sbyin pa'i phyir/ /madz+dza 1la sogs gzhan rnams la/ /g.yas phyogs su ni pa na sha /blag 2sha dang ni u dus+thār / /tsan+dan arka 4bha tā rnams/ /yal ga be yi kaṅka dang / /a bha sa mi shaṃ bha ri/ /a ba marga a shwaza5/ /byang chub shing las byung ba rnams/ /rlon pa drang zhing rtse gcig pa/ /srin bu sogs kyis ma zos pa/ /mje chung gi ni mtho gang la/ /dri zhim chu yis khrus byas la/ /mar byugs til dang drur ba bzang ma chag pa yi 'bras rnams kyang / /zho zan ku sha so ba dang / /nas dang gro dang 23— /9

mon sren gre/ /sran gre'u 'bras yos de bzhin gzhan/ /sbrang rtsi 'o ma la sogs srid/ /rim pa bzhin du bzhag nas ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum dag rnal 'byor pas/ /zhi ba'i gtor ma byin nas ni/ /sbyin sreg las ni yang dag brtsam / /mtho gang gting du brkos byas nas/ /khru gang 'khor lo zlum po la//bde gshegs bzhi yi phyag mtshan dang / /bdag po'i phyag mtshan dbus su'o/ /de bzhin dbus su bgegs kyi dgra/ /las kun byed pa'i phyag mtshan no/ /pad+ma rab tu rgyas 'dra ba/ / ngos bzhi 1sor bzhi bor nas ni/ /de yi tshad kyang kha khyer la/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje phreng 2ba yongs brtsigs pas/ /phyi rol kha khyer kun du bskor/ /'og gi phyag mtshan phyi rol du//rdo rje phreng ba gang smra ba/ /de rnams phyag mtshan gzhan dag gi/ /rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan las cung zad/ /de bzhin du yang bzang zhabs kyis/ /sor ni brgyad dang gabyug gi tshad/ /mchu 4dang rngams su rtsa ba yi/ /phyag mtshan shin tu brtan pas na/ /de bzhin du ni 5gzhan dag kyang / /'di ni rig pas brtag 6par 'dod/ /yang na bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ /che la gzhan ni dman pa yi/ /phyag mtshan zhes su brjod pa ni/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor ji ltar mnyam/ /phyag mtshan rnams kyi brgal ba 'di/ /lan ni ji ltar 'debs par byed/ /der yang mkhas pas mi mnyam par/ /skyes bu dam pas 'dod ma yin/ /phyi rol rdo rje 'phro ba yis/ /bskor ba 'di ni mi 'gal te/ /de rnams phyag mtshan la ltos nas/ /de bzhin phyi rol bsgral 'dod na/ /'bras/ bu med cing dka' ba sgre1 / /blo ldan ji ltar nye bar brten/ /lung dang rigs pas sgrub byed pa/ /phyogs 'di la ni yod ma yin/ /skyon yang cung 23—pya0

zad byin pa ste/ /rgya che mang pos ci zhig bya/ /de ltar bstan pa'i thab khung du/ /sngags kyis sbar ba'i me la ni/ /'bar ba'i ched du mar ni blugs/ /de la 'dir ni me sbar ba'i sngags te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ hūṃ/ shar phyogs kha bstan ku sha rnams/ /g.yas skor 1gyis ni sbyin par bya/ /re re nas rgo shar phyogs rtse/ /thab khung ku shas dgab par bya/ /thab khung bdag med par dmigs nas/ /ram̐ las byung ba'i ser skya ser/ /g.yas g.yon zhal ni gnag dang dkar/ /lus thung zhal ni ser po ste/ /shes rab las 2'khyud ral pa 'greng / /ril pa dbyug pa g.yon pa na/ /g.yas pa skyabs sbyin phreng ba ste/ /pad+mar ram̐ skyes me dkyil 'khor/ /zhi ba la sogs cha byad can/ /rdzas 4kyi rjes mthun me ru bsam / /me mtshams nas ni ye shes me/ /mig gsum ṭak+kis 5dgug par bya/ /yang na de yi rang sngags kyis/ /bsang gtor la sogs brtsam 6par bya/ /de la 'di ni me'i sngags te/ oṃ e bye hi ma hā bhu ta de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza sad ta ma kṛ hi twa a hu ti swā hā re/ asmin sasgo hi to / bha ba/ ku sha'i chun pos bsang gtor ro/ /lan gsum bar du chu ru gzhug /de bzhin cho ga'i rim pa yis / /slar yang zhabs bsil sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin chu yi mchod yon sbyin / /me tog dang bcas lan gsum du/ /mdzub mo mje bong kha gnyis ni//dang po mtha' ru mos pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ji ltar zhabs sogs la/ /blo yis zhabs bsil sogs brtag bya/ /kun du lus la bsang gtor sbyin/ /zhabs bsil zhabs ni gnyis la yang / /blo yis zhabs bsil zhal du ste/ /spyi bor yon chab dbul bar bya/ /de la 'di ni mchod pa'i rim/ /rnge tog spyi bor mar me sogs/ /mdun du dri zhim brang du'o/ /dam tshig dang ni ye shes me/ /pho3—3/

'o ma chu sbyin slar yang gcig /bsang gtor la sogs cho ga yis/ /cho ga 'dis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /chang gzungs 1'tsham par sbom pa ste/ /ring du khru gang sor drug pa/ /rin chen rdo rje yu bar bcas2/ /sor mo bzhi ni kha khyer la / /sor gnyis brkos la rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje can gyi sor mo bzhi/ /brkos te chu byes 'dab ma la/ /mtha' ru ji ltar mdzes pas mdzes/ /dgang gzar las ni mje chung tshad/ /ro ni rgyu ba'i bu gar ldan/ /rdo rje dpangs su ji ltar thos/ /rim pa rtse lnga rtse gsum pa/ /blugs gzar pad+ma'i 'dab rnams la/ /sor gcig brkos pas rdo rje 'dzin/ /sor gnyis sngar bzhin yu ba la/ /rin chen rdo rje rtse rdo rje/ /dgang gzar sbyin sreg shing rang bzhin/ /blugs gzar de bzhin nim 4rang bzhin/ /zangs sogs rdzas las yang dag byung / /rang nyid sngags las bskyed 5pa'o/ /pus mo gnyis kyi nang ngos su/ /lag g.yon steng bstan dgang gzar du/ /mar gyis 6gang ba yang dag blugs/ /g.yas nga/'i 'og tu kha bstan pas/ /blugs/ gzar dgang gzar la bskyon la/ /steng du bltas pa mar gyis padagang / /lha yi gzugs su bskyed pa yis/ /ram̐ yig tshangs zhal dgod par bya/ /yon bdag nus pas lan bdun nam/ /lan gsum dag tu mkhas pa yis/ /dgang gzar la rgo bskor byas nas/ /dgang blugs rab tu sbyin par bya/ /de la 'di ni sngags te/ oṃ agha ye ā dī bya ā dī bya a bi ṣa a bi ṣa 9ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya 0ā bā na ye swā hā/ dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma rnams/ /blo dang ldan pas brtag par bya/ /dge ba'i 'od zer bsgril 'bar ba/ / brgya sbyin gzhu ltar yongs ston pa/ /mdog sogs de dang de spyor ba/ /las kyi rjes su mthun pas ston/ /gang tshe 23—52

mtshan ma ma mthong na/ /yang ni bgegs dgra'i bzlas pa bya/ /rab tu legs par zhabs bsel sogs/ /byas nas me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /dgang blugs sbyin bya de bzhin du/ /yam shing sogs kyis sbyin sreg bya/ /slar yang 'thor 'thung la sogs pa/ /me yi phung po la byas nas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar dmigs te/ /'di yi sngags ni bzlas par 1bya/ /mchod yon zhabs bsel sogs byas nas/ /mchod yon dam pa sngon 'gro bas/ /de la dgang blugs sbyin par bya/ /bdud rtsir byas pa'i mar gyis ni/ /sngon du bsams shing bsreg par bya/ /re mos gnyis ni sbyin byas la/ /mje bong srin lag kha yis ni/ /blangs pa mar gyi rtsi blugs pa/ /blugs gzar gyis ni mar bsreg bya / /'bru yang de nyid kyis dbul bya/ /med na lag pa nyid kyis bya/ /dgang blugs dag ni sbyin par bya/ /bsreg bya 'bru rnams rang gi ni/ /sngags kyis bud shing de bzhin du/ /kha byug 4gzhan gye sngags kyis kyang / /gzhan ni rang gis dbul bar bya/ /de la 'di rnams be+e gzhan gyi sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra agha 5le swā hā/ mar gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a/ dzā lā ya sru/ hā/ u dus+thā ri'i'o / /oṃ bo bye bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ byang chub kyi shing gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra la tā ya swā hā/ pa la sha'i'o/ / /oṃ badz+ra ku be rā ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha'i'o/ /oṃ/ badz+ra sā ha ka rā ya swā hā/ a mra'i'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā rka ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e dzā ya swā hā/so ba'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro'i'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā 5ya sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til gyi'o4/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā rka ya swā hā/ mon sran gre'u'i'o / /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ drur ba'i'orka9/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/23—bye3

'bras ma chag pa'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho zan kyi'o/ /bsang gtor 'thor 'thung la sogs pa/ /byas nas sngar bzhin mtha' ru ni/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /las ni ji ltar nang bcug la/ /ngal bso 1nas ni slar sbyin bya/ /dgang blugs ji ltar yod kyi bar/ /med na yang dag sdogs pa yi/ /mtha' ru yang dag dgang blugs dbul/ /'thor 'thung dri zhim me so rtsi/ /me tog spos dang gos gsar pa/ /phul nas bdug spos dril bu dkrol/ /sgra yis mchod pa byas nas ni/ /yon phul nas ni slob ma yi//g.yas kyi mje bo g.yon pa yi ༄/ /mje chung nas ni bzung byas nas/ /rang gi dgang blugs sbyin nga/ra bya/ /gal te grub nas rgyal po sogs/ /dge ba'i ched du bsngo bar bya/ /yongs rdzogs dgang blugs sngon lta bur/ /'thor 'thung la sogs byas nas ni/ /yon phul nas ni slob ma yi/ /sems ni mnyam par bzhag nas su/ /snying gar me tog thal mo sbyar/ /nyung sogs nyes pa zhi don du/ /bzod par gsol zhes brjod par bya/ /ji srid ma tshang lhag pa rnams// /bdag gis d+mongs pa bro bgyis 4pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /mgon po khyed kyis de bzod mdzod/ /ma tshogs pa dang mi shes pa/ /nus nga/ med la sogs rang bzhin/ /ma tshang ba dang gzhan byas gang / /de dag thams cad bzod par rigs/ /bzod gsol phyag 'tshal byas rjes la/ /rang gi mngon par 'dod pa blang / /rdo rje sems zhes bzlas pa bya/ /mang po yang ni yi ge brgya pa'i sngags te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/badz+ra satwa twe no nga/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/a nu rak+to gre bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥ6ku ru hūṃ/23—5/

ha ha ha ha ho bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ i to ba sarba satwarja/ sedhi dad thā ya bta su 1kha/ gats+tsha dh+wa budhe zibi ṣa yo pu na rā ga ma na ya tu/ brjod nas rang gi sngags kyis ni/ /yi ge'i nang du bcug nas su/ /sngags kyis rang bdag mgon po ni/ /sngags pas blo yis gshegs su gsol/ /de ltar me yi de bzhin kun/ /bsang gtor la sogs byas nas ni/ /de la dgang blugs rdosbyin byas nas/ /yam shing de bzhin sbyin sreg bya/ /de bzhin 'di yis zhabs bsil sogs/ /ji srid na bza' dbul byas nas/ /bzod gsol gsol ba gdab byas nas/ /snga ma bzhin du gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid mnyam bzhag 4pas/ /me la 'o ma bsgrubs byas nas/ /lha rnams la phul lhag ma ni/ /phru ba 'dod pas bgo bar bya/ /di ring phal cher rigs dam pa/ /ran par 'dod pa yod pa ni/ /des na 'di brtsams mgon bo rnams/ /thub pa'i rtse mo de bzod mdzod/ /rgyud rnams mang ngo/ gang rig pa/ /rab gnas blo ni pha rol son / /'di dag byis pas bstan pas na/ /nyes ldan bdag la bzod par 5mdzod / /rab gnas cho ga bzang po 'di/ /rab tu rgyas/ par yo/da mod kyang / /dman pas de nyid mi rtogs pas/ /des na bdag gis/ 'di ru brtsams/ /'di ni mdor bsnyus yang dag rdzogs/ /rab gnas cho ga go rims mdzes /'di byas bsod nams gang thob pas/ /'gro ba byang chub la gnas gyur/ /rmongs pa rjes bzung las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams cung zad bsgoms pas na/ /dang/la ldan mkhas pa mi 'jigs pa'i/ /phyag gis cho ga sdeb spyor byas/ /paṇ+ḍi ta mi 'jigs pa'i phyag gis mdzad pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsnyus pa 23—55

〉〉dumā ba'i'o/ 〈〈pe 〉〉thrak+ṣa ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rnyik+ṣa ya/23—56

༄/ /rgya che ba'i tshig bsdus pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi ṣa da pa da saṃ gra ho nā ma pra tiṣ+ṭha bi bye/bod skad du/ rgya che ba'i tshig bsdus pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga /dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po'i mtshon gyi rnam pa mtshungs / /mchog tu dga' bas mdzes pa yi/ /shes rab zab mo dang ldan pa / /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'khor lor bcas/ /btud nas kā tsar mngon brjod pas/ /sna tshogs slob dpon bzhed rig cing / /sna tshogs rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyas shing gsal bas 'jigs rnams la/ /nyung zhing gsal ba'i rjes 'brangs pa/ /de la shes rab ldan pa dag /bde blag 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ /rab gnas cho ga brjod par bya/ /sgu gzugs rab gnas ma byas la / /mchod dang phyag 'tshal gsol ba ni/ /sngags kyis dman pa'i sbyin sreg gi/ /thal ba 'bras med ji bzhin no/ /rab tu mi gnas chos rnams la/ /23—pya8

'dir ni gang du rab gnas ni/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug la bstan nas/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis rab gnas gsungs/ /gang du sgu gzugs grub nas ni/ /yun ring gnas shing ma mchod pa/ /ji srid mchod pa'i 'os ma gyur/ /der ni legs pa ma yin 'byung / /rtag tu cho ga ma tshang ba'i/ /rab gnas bya ba smad pa nyid/ /tshe 'dir sbug bsngal che 'byung zhing / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /de phyir dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /bdag nyid nus pas 'chad 'gyur gyi/ /cho ga'i bya ba'i rim pa yis/ /rab tu 'bad de bya ba nyid//zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang / /tshes ni bdun du bstan pa nyid/ /rab gnas las la nges bstan pa/ /rgyu skar rnams ni bcu bzhi'o/ /dgun tha dpyid ra dpyid tha dang / /dbyar zla ra 'bring dgun zla ra/ /gza' rgo phur bu lhag pa dang / /pa sangs bzhi pa zla ba'o/ /tshes ni lnga dang bdun nyid dang / /de bzhin gnyis dang bcu pa dang / /gsum pa dang ni zla ba nya/ /bcu gsum rnams te bdun po bzang / /rgyal dang me bzhi lha mtshams dang / /snar ma dang ni gro bzhin mgo/ /smad dang spyon dang snrubs dang lag /khrums dang de bzhin chu stod do/ /skar ma smad la rab gnas bya/ /der ni shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nam yang yid la gnas pa yi/ /dngos grub tu ni me bzhis 'gyur / /lung rnams yongs su shes pa ni/ /snrubs dang gro bzhin gyis yin no / /lag la skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /snar ma yis ni nor 'byung 'gyur//ri dwags mgo yis zhi bar bstan/ /chu stod kyis ni bu rnams 'tsho/ /khrums kyis yang dag 'phel bar bshad/ /rgyal gyis rtag tu rgyal ba'o/ /spyon la dge dang skal ba bzang / /lha mtshams kyis ni mchog rab ster/ /yang dag skar 23—59

ma dang mthun pas/ /ji skad bshad pa thams cad bya/ /gsum pa bdun pa drug pa dang / /bcu dang bcu gcig zla ba rnams/ /dang po lnga pa gsum pa dang / /tha ma yang ni rnam par spang / /dgu dang brgyad dang bcu gnyis nyid//bzhi dang lnga dang brde nyid/ /rnam pa gzhan du byed pa la/ /bzlog pa'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can dman pa'i dbang mdzad nas/ /zla ba la sogs bzang ba 'di'o/ /mchog gi dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /nges pa nyid ni rigs ma yin/ /de ltar yang / dbyar ni dngos grub gnas su 'gyur / /ston ka rnal 'byor sbyin pa nyid/ /dgun stod sangs rgyas ye shes ster / /dgun smad 'byor ba kun sbyin byed/ /dpyid ni phun sum tshogs rab ster/ /sos ka rgyal dang zhi ba ster/ /dus rnams kun du sangs rgyas ni/ /rab tu gnas la bzhugs par 'dod/ /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du yang / rtag tu gtsug tor bcing bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya/ /grub par gyur pa de'i mod la/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /mi bdag dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /'di la gza' dang rgyu skar med/ /bgegs dang log 'dren dag kyang med/ /gang zhig yid la ci 'dod pa/ /skye zhing skye bar grub par 'gyur/ /bsrung dang dbang bskur gtor ma bzlas dang dbye ba dang / /phyir bzlog pa dang dkyil 'khor dang ni sgrub thabs dang / /btsan thabs spyor ba dang ni gshegs su gsol ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis de nyid bcu zhes rab tu gsungs/ /slob dpon de nyid 'di dag rig /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngags dang phyag 23—60

rgya'i cho ga shes/ /rab tu gnas pa bya bar 'os/ /de nas khrus dang gtsang sbra'i bdag /rab tu gnas pa byed brtson pa'i/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas—/ /thal mos bla mar gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ni gzhan rnams thams cad kun/ /rab tu bsgral bar 'dod pa yis/ /bgyis pa dang ni bris pa yi/ /sku gzugs ras ris glegs bam dag /ji ltar nus dang rjes mthun pas/ /'di dag rab gnas bgyi bar 'tshal/ /dgyes pa'i thugs ni kun bskyed nas/ /bdag gi rab gnas mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar don du gnyer nas ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin legs bltas/ /bdag gis dad pas shes rab kyi/ /pha rol phyin pa 'bum pa bris/ /gang yang dge la rab 'bad pas/ /srung ba lnga la sogs pa bris/ /'bum bu gleng ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /ras ris 'bad pas bris byas shing / /rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas mchog gyur pa/ /gtsug lag khang ni yongs rdzogs bgyis/ /rgyal ba'i sku gdung dag gi ni/ /mchod rten bdag gis legs par bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas gnas kyi tshul du ni/ /dri yi gtsang khang 'bad pas bgyis/ /khron pa kun dga' ra ba dang / /byug pa'i sku gzugs la sogs dang / /sangs rgyas kyis ni mang gsungs pa'i/ /lugs ma sogs la rab tu 'bad/ /sems can rnams ni tshim byed pa'i/ /rdzing bu yid du 'ong ba bgyis/ /sems can rnams ni bde byed pa'i/ /dze+e ghā li ni yongs sgogs bgyis/ /dar ba'i blo ldan slob ma yi/ /dang por gus pas lan gsum gsol / /slob ma dag par shes nas ni/ /stegs bu yang dag brtsam par bya//gru bzhi pa la khru bzhi pa/ /dpangs kyi tshad ni khru gnyis pa/ /chu shing ka ba sogs ldan pa/ /nyams dga' cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /der ni stan 'jam 23—61

bde ba la/ /blo bzang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /gtsug tor bcings shing lus chas bzang / /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyin/ /dbang po rdo rje can ni 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul du byung ba 'di bzhes shig /me dang gshin rje bden bral 'byung po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung dang nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ba'i tshogs bcas la/ /so so so sor phul ba 'di bzhes la/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /gtor ma me tog bdug pa phul ba 'di/ /dgyes par gsol zhing bsnams te bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /rab gnas rtsa ba bkra shis dang / /dag pa'i chu yi khrus nyid de/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa nyid du bshad/ /de dag grangs ni bcu dgu ru/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bshad/ /de dag nyid dang mnyam bshad pa/ /las kun phyed dang nyi shu'o/ /yang na ji ltar 'byor ba dang / /mthun par bcu'am lnga'am gcib/ /bum pa rnams kyi nang na ni/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /sor mo bdun gyi tshad kyis ni/ /mgul pa mtho zhing rnam par mdzes/ /mchu 'phyang ba ni sor gnyis so/ /lto ldir mtho ni lnga pa can/ /gal te tshad 'dis dman gyur na/ /sbyin bdag la ni shis pa min/ /baṃ gyi yi ge las byung ba'i/ /rin chen 'byung gnas cher 'bar ba'o/ /gzhan la nges 23—62

pa yod min te/ /med na ji ltar mdzes pa'o/ /'bru dang rin chen sman snying po / /rigs kyi mtshan mas rnam par mdzes/ /nas dang gro dang so ba mchog /til dang sran mar mngon brjod pa'o/ /mu tig dngul dang gser zhes bya/ /mu men dang ni byi ru rnams/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri z-i ha ste/ /de bzhin sa ha de ba dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub dkar po dang / /lnga pa dbyug pa'i ut+pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan ma ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjer rab tu bsgrags/ /blo dang ldan pas kha dog lnga/ /yang dag ldan par shes par bya/ /mi bskyod pa yi rdo rje ni/ /nag po rtse mo lnga dang ldan/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad mtshan ma'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan mtshan ma ni/ /rin chen margad cha dgu pa/ /'od dpag med kyi mtshan ma ni/ /'dam skyes dmar po yang dag 'byung / /de bzhin don yod ral gri ni/ /kha dog sngo bsangs 'od zer bcas/ /spyan ma yi ni spyan zur dag /mdog sngon mig 'bras bzang po can / /mā ma gī ni rdo rje sngo/ /dkar mo'i 'dam skes dmar po'o/ /gser kyi ut+pa la'i mtshan ma/ /sgrol ma'i yin par rab tu bsgrags/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi rdo rje ma'i/ /mtshan ma me long dri med dkar/ /rab mdzes pi wang sngon po ni/ /de bzhin sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /de bzhin dri yi rdo rje ma'i/ /btso ma gser gyi 'od can dung / /ro yi rdo rje ma'i mtshan ma/ /bcud kyi snod ni dmar po'o/ /de bzhin reg bya rdo rje ma'i/ /mtshan ma kha dog gis brgyan gos//chos kyi dbyengs ma'i mtshan ma ni/ /de bzhin mdog dkar gru gsum pa'o/ /gshin rje'i dgra yi mtshan ma ni/ /rdo rje tho ba mdog nag po/ /shes rab mthar byed kyi mtshan ma/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar/ /pad+ma mthar 23—63

byed kyi pad+ma/ /mdog dmar du ni rab tu bsgrags/ /bgeg kyi dgra yi rdo rje ni / /kha gdengs yang dag bstan ji bzhin/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla dkyil la//gtso bo'i mtshan ma bri bar bya/ /shar sogs phyogs su gnas pa'i 'dab ma dmar 'od can/ /rlung dang me yi 'dab ma ser po'i ngo bo ste/ /yi dwags bdag dang dbang ldan phyogs kyi chu skyes mdog /drur ba dang ni sngo bsangs sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /rnam snang mdzad dang lha mo bcu'i/ /dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin spro bar bya/ /gzhan ni ji ltar rigs pa bzhin/ /gtum 'od dkyil 'khor la bri bya/ /lnga yi phyogs la mtshan ma bzhi/ /ngos su bdag po'i gdong la bri/ /spyan ma la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /mtshan ma bum pa gcig la bri/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma sogs kyi/ /mtshan ma drug ni gcig la'o/ /khro bo gsum gyi mtshan ma ni/ /gcig la'o gcig ni de bzhin gcig /bcu yi phyogs la lha mo bzhi'i/ /mtshan ma de bzhin re re dang / /khro bo rnams kyi so so ste/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin du bri/ /dkar po dri yi chu yis gang / /mgrin pa dkar ser gos dang ldan/ /a mra'i lcug mas mdzes pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /bsams byas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhu ba'i rnam par yang gyur pa/ /rnam rgyal sogs la rab tu gzhug /thod pa'i steng du phreng ba'i rtser/ /rdo rje btags pa der bzhag nas/ /de nas sngags pas mtshan ma rnams/ /bdag po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra satwa hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i'o/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra byeka hūṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i'o/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o//oṃ āḥrat+na j-ika hūṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyi'o/ /oṃ āḥ.ā ro dzaka hūṃ/ 'od 23—61

—dpag med kyi'o/ /oṃ s+dzapradz+nyā dh+rika hūṃ/ don yod grub pa'i'o/ /oṃ s+dzamo ha ra ti t+t+waṃ/ spyan ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥdre ṣa ra ti hūṃ/ mā ma tī'i'o/ /oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūṃ/ dkar mo'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūṃ/ sgrol ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥrū pa badzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥshasda badzā hūṃ/ oṃ spyogan+dha badzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥr sa badzā hūṃ/oṃ āḥspar+sha badzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdharma badzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbibyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan mas mtshan/ /yang na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /mtshan mas mtshan la de nyid kyi/ /sngags kyis lhag par gnas par bya/ /bstod pa lnga ni sngon 'gro ba'i/ /mchod pa kun gyis yang dag mchod//mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyangs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal chos/ /rdo rje dbyangs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab / /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /rdo rje dbyangs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bya ba rtsom pa thams cad la/ /blo bzang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin / /bgegs kun nye bar zhi ched du/ /dang po tha mar gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas lag pa g.yas brkyang la/ /nyi mar hūṃ yig rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ ma hā 23—65

badz+ra hūṃ swā hā/ cig shos la yang zla bar ni/ /a yig rnam par bsgom par bya//oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghar+bhe āḥswā hā/ zhes pas byin brlabs gtor ma sbyin/ /yi ge brgya pa lan bdun bzla/ /de la 'di ni yi ge brgya pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba / su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ sat+tha sedhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sat+tha kadz+re su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān sadze+e ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ/ de ltar byas nas nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //sgu gzugs la sogs mtshan nyid bzang / /mtshan mo lhag par gnas par bya/ /de nas shar du zhal phyogs pa'i/ /yang na gzhan du phyogs te gzhag/rdo rje khu tshur yungs kar bcas/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i spyor ba yis lan gsum nges par bskor bya zhing / /de nas me dang chu la dor/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /gser snod la sogs rnams dang ni/ /gos gzhan kaṅka ṇa sogs dang / /shī ta li kā la sogs dang / /kham phor sogs kyis nges par bya/ /mchod yon la sogs bsang gtor bar/ /snod ni mabyu'i steng du'o/ /zangs kyi snod ni shin tu yang / /las kun pa la rab tu shis/ /oṃ pra ba ra saṭ+wā rār+ghaspra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lag pa dag kha sbyar bas dung gi mchod yon no/ /oṃ pra ba ra sad+ku rā pā bye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mthe bong mdzub mo dang bcas pa dag gis rnge tog gcig blangs nas 'gying ba dang bcas pas mthe chung dang mje bong dag bkrol bas zhabs bsil lo oṃ 23—66

pra ba ra saṭ+wā rā tsa ma ni pra ṭīts+tsha swā hā/ mdzub mo dang mthe bong dag gis chu blangs te dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ pra ba ra saṅgā ra prok+ṣa khaṃ pra t+t+waṃts+tsha swā hā/ lag pas ku sha'i chun pos bsang gtor ro/ /mchod yon la sogs pa 'di thams cad rnam pa gsum du bya'o/ /bgegs dgra'i sngags kyi spyor ldan pa'i/ /ba byung lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /drur ba'i pir la sogs pa yis/ /mi bskor bar ni bkru bar bya/ /ba lang lci ba chu dang ni/ /mar dang zho dang 'o mar bcas/ /lha yi khrus ni sgrub pa la/ /ba byung lnga ru shes par bya/ /phyi ba dang ni chu bor nas / /'o ma zho dang mar ldan pa/ /ka ra sbrang rtsir bcas pa ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga zhes 'dir brjod bya/ /u dusmra ra shi rī ṣa/ /ashwat+tha dang parka ti/ /pa ta rnams ni mdangs 'gugs phyir/ /de dag shing shun lnga zhes bya/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /dri bzang til mar sngags kyis so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ shing shun lnga dang dri yis kyang / /de bzhin byugs shing nges par bkru/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang grarji lā/ /de bzhin kha che a ka ru/ /dri lnga zhes ni rab brjod de/ /lha yi khrus la brten pa yin/ /rgyal po dbang bsgur tshul du ni/ /glu dang gar dang dga' ston che/ /blo ldan spyan sogs phyag bzung ba'i/ /bum pa rnams kyis sgu khrus gsol/ /dang por rnam rgyal bum pas te/ /de nas rnam snang mdzad sogs kyis/ /spyan ma sogs kyis de ma thag /gshin rje'i gshed sogs bum pa yis/ /sngags pas tshigs bcad 'don zhing bya/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sgu khrus gsol / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhe ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ ri mor bris pa la 23—67

sogs pa/ /thams cad me long la chus bkru/ /rdzas la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis / /dze+eng bu dang ni gtsug lag khang / /dze+e ghā li dang dri gtsang khang / /la sogs me long ngos la bkru/ /ras ris la ni chu med pa'i/ /gur gum byugs shing pañtsa ra/ /mdangs gsal shis shing bkra ba yi/ /gos sar gyis ni yang dag dkri/ /oṃ badz+ra bā sa se swā hā/ oṃ badzā bha ra ṇa bhū ṣa ṇi swā hā/ chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /bdag gis dad pas dbul lags kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/lhan skyes de bzhin sbyar las byung / /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod//oṃ s+dzabadz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /shangs ni tshim byed dri 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol / /oṃ āḥbadz+ra gabye hūṃ/ mun sel 'bru mar rtsi mar skyes/ /lha rdzas 'bar ba'i mar me 'di/ /mi shes thams cad rab zhi'i slad/ /bdag nyid dad pas dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dībye hūṃ/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing //bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai bi bye hūṃ/ rdzing bu khron pa'i mthil son skyes/ /sems can thams cad tshim par byed/ /kun nas dag pa'i chab 'di dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /nā ga parje'i 'dab ldan zhing / /pū ga dzā ti yang dag ldan/ /ga pur dang bcas tshems rtsi dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra tām+bu le hūṃ/de ltar mchod pa byas te/ de nas sngar bshad pa'i mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa'i 23—— 68

tshigs bcad kyis bstod cing / bkra shis gang zhig la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis yang yang bstod par bya'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /de yis de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs pa/ /dbang bcas lha rnams kyis ni bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /de yis de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan mdzad dam pa gtsang ma'i mchog /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan thub pa shākya seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /de yis de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa thams cad spyan drangs te ji ltar rigs par me tog la sogs pa rnams dang /gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bstod pa byas nas mkhas pas bdud rtsi myangs te/ zhal bsel dang tām+bu la phul nas thal mo sbyar bas phyag 'tshal te me tog 'thor zhing 'di skad brjod do/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta su la li ta bi lā sa na 23—69

mi tairtswa mā mi bha ga bāt+t+waṃ shrī mañdzu badzā bye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥpra tits+tsha saṃ ku su māñdza lin+d+ra tha hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya satwa haṃ zhes so/ /de nas bdug spos thogs byas nas/ /pus mo sa gzhi la bkod de/ /'byon 'gyur mgon po spyan 'dren pa'i/ /tshig 'di ched du brjod par bya/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs bste'i bdag nyid can/ /rab tu gnas pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /sems can bsod nams spel phyir dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni der gus la/ /bka' drin dag ni mdzad par 'os/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan du ni bzhugs pa las/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs pa/ /de bzhin 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /khyem gnas rnams kyi don slad dang / /byang chub sems ni 'phel slad du/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes la/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs gsol/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /dgra bcom byang chub sems rnams dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su sangs rgyas spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /ci nus pa yi nyer spyod kyis/ /rab tu gnas pa bgyi bar 'tshal/ /sgu gzugs rab tu gnas pa'i phyogs la ni/ /bsten pa la sogs bgyi bar 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse ba nyer bzung nas/ /dam tshig dang bcas thams cad ni//nye bar gnas par mdzad par 'os/ /zhes so/ /lugs ma la sogs pa'i sku 23— 70

gzugs la dang por gsol ba gdab pa gsum byas nas sgrub pa chen po'i mthar/lugs ma la sogs pa skad cig gis sam/ khang pa brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa'i bdag nyid 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pas mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs te dam tshig sems dpa' rnam par bsams te de'i thugs ka'i sngags kyis sngar bshad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin rnams dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gshin rje mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang bgegs mthar byed rnams kyis dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya'o/ /glegs bam dang rig sngags dang bzlas pa'i phreng ba rnams la di gsung rdo rje yi ge'i rnam pa yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa' gzhug go/ /gtsug lag khang la sogs pa la ni rnam par mdzad de'i rnam pa yongs su gyur pa bcug ste me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de snga ma bzhin du yi ge brgya pa yongs su bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /be+er yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod de ji ltar rigs par gshegs su gsol bar bya'o zhes pa lha lhag par gnas pa dang / gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas nyi ma gzhan la snga dro'i dus su gshegs su gsol ba ma gtogs pa ji skad bshad pa thams cad bya'o/ /de la mig la sogs pa byen gyis brlab pa ni/ /23ke7/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /k+ṣiṃ yig dkar dang 'khor lo skyes/ /zhal dang sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin can/ /mig la sa yi snying por bshad/ /rna ba la gnas phyag rdo rje/ /zla bar rdza yig rdo rje gnas/ /mi bskyod pa yi gzugs 'dra'o/ /zla bar khaṃ dang rin chen skyes//nam mkha'i snying po sna yi nang / /'di yi zhal mdog mtshan ma ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'dra ba'o/ /sgol ma'i bdag por yang dag gnas/ /tai dang mtsho skyes las byung ba/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lce la ste/ /zla sogs 'od dpag med bzhin no/ /spyi bor ri bong mtshan gzugs gnas/ /ske skyes ral gri bzang po las/ /zhal sogs don yod dang mtshungs pa'i/ /'dren pa rnam sel spyi bo la'o/ /zla bar saṃ dang rdo rje las/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan can/ /snying gar kun du bzang por bshad/ /byang chub sems su rnam par bsgom/ /spyi bo'i zla bar oṃ las byung / /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad las skyes pa/ /sa yi snying po dang 'dra ba'i/ /sku yi rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /mgrin par a yig las pad+ma/ /der ni a yig las sprul pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu yi/ /gsung gi rdo rje rnam par bsam/ /snying ga'i zla bar hūṃ yig las/ /skyes pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /sngags pas thugs kyi dbang po bsgom / /phyag na rdo rje lta bu gzhan/ /thams cad rdo rje skyil krung can/ /cod pan rin chen 'od 'phro ba/ /mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rang 'od shes rab lus chags ldan/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje bzung ste gnas gsum du bskor ba gsum byas nas de nyid gsum lan gsum gyis sgu gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ dngul gyi snod mkhra kā ra mig sman mar 23—72

dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa bzhag nas gser gyi thur mas spyan dbye bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tre hūṃ/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣu m+mube+e sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥzhes pas me long bstan par bya'o/ /me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa rnams kyis phyogs skyong ba rnams kyang 'bad pas mchod par bya ste/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ asna ye swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ne+e rje te swā hā/ oṃ ba ru shā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā ya be swā hā/ oṃ ku be+e rā ya swā hā/ oṃ i shā nā ya swā hā/oṃ ur+ghaṃ brad+ma ṇi swā hā/ oṃ ā sgoḥthra thi bye swā hā/ oṃ be ma tsi tri bh+yaḥswā hā/zhes pas so/ /de nas glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs/ /legs darngol 'di yis bzod gsol bya/ /gang yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /lha dang de yi sras rnams dang / /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyes bzod mdzad de/ /spyin pa'i bdag po chen po la/ /kun du zhi dang bde legs mdzod/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /gang 'dir rab tu gnas gyur la/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa brgya ru yang / /sa chu me dang rlung rnams las/ /lha rnams kun gyis bsrung du gsol/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo'ang srung mdzad de/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /rang gnas bzang por gshegs su gsol/ /de nas brtse ldan bla ma yis/ /slob ma bos nas 'di skad smra/ /khyod kyis sngon du gang gsol ba/ /rab gnas mchod yon mchod pa dag /de ni nga yis byas zin gyi/ /de ni ci bder mchod pa gyis/ /dri gtsang khang sogs bzhugs nas ni/ /rab sbyin nyes par 'gyur ma yin/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badzā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de khri la sogs par bzhag nas mnyes 23—73

—par bya'o/ /de nas bzo bo la sogs dang / /gzhan rnams la yang mchod par bya/ /de bzhin mgon med rnams la yang / /sbyin pa ji ltar nus pa sbyin//dong dgang rab tu gnas pa la/ /'khor lor sbyin sreg gang nus pa/ /de kun slob dpon nyid kyis zhes/ /rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pas gsungs/ /sngar bzhin seng ge 'phrog byed la sogs pa'i/ /lugs ma la sogs kun kyang rab gnas bya/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang bsgur ba/ /lha rnams kun la kun du dbang byed 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnal 'byor mchog /sngags pas cho ga bzhin bsams nas/ /rjing bu la sogs de dag rnams / /sgu'i dbang po ste chu lha'i gzugs/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ru na hūṃ zhes pa 'di yongs su gyur pa las klu brgyad du byas te/ klu'i gnas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu'i bdag nyid rdo rje'i chu lhar bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod do/ /rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i tshul gyis spyan drangs pa de nyid du bcug pas de nyid kyis yongs su gang ste chu'i rgyun gyis 'og gzhi'i bar khyab par bsam mo/ /de'i dbus su gnas pa de'i gzugs brnyan kyi klu lus gdengs ka can spyi bor 'khor lo 'dzin pa shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang phyogs bral rnams su gser la sogs pa las yongs su bsgrubs pa'i klu'i dbang po rnams dngos su gzhag par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ mtha' yas gser las byas pa ste/ /de bzhin nor rgyas bu dngul las/ /'jog po zangs las byas rig bya/ /khar ba las kyang karko ṭa/ /de bzhin ra gan gyis pad+ma/ /zha nye dkar pos pad+ma che/ /de bzhin zha nyes dung skyong ngo / /lcags las de bzhin rigs ldan yin/ /de bzhin du kun dga' ra ba la sogs pa rnams kyang rdo rje 23—7/

rnam par snang mdzad yongs su gyur pa las ji lta ba bzhin du de'i rnam pas rab tu gnas par bya'o zhes pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //ma dran pa dang ma nus pas/ /gal te cho ga chad gyur pa/ /rab gnas byas pa'i de ma thag /sbyin sreg gis ni bskang bar bya/ /zhi dang rgyas sogs dbye ba yis/ /thabs ni rnam pa mang du bzhed/ /gzhung rgyas pa yi 'jigs pa yis/ /las kun byed pa bri bar bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rnams kyis ni/ /sngon du sa gzhi sbyang bya ste/ /lag pa g.yas ni brkyang byas pa/ /rdo rjer bcas pas sa la bsnun/ /oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ sa sbyang ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /thab zlum po rgyar khru gang ba zabs su brkos pa sor bcu gnyis la thab kyi steng nas sor bzhi nang du dor nas de'i tshad kyis ge sar pad+ma rgyas pa'i rnam pa can no/ /de'i phyi'i thad kar dpangs su sor bzhi pa'i stegs bu phyogs mtshams rnams rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'o/ /thab tu rang gi lha'i sa bon las byung ba ba byung gis nye bar byugs pa'i zlum po dkar po'o/ /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du rdo rje dpangs su sor gcig gi tshad can dang srid du yang sor brgyad pa'i 'khor lo dang rin po che dang chu skyes dang ral gri rnams bri bar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i steng phyi rol du rdo rje phreng ba byas te sngags pa shar du phyogs par gyur pas/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed de/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes par byed/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /che ge mo la zhi bar mdzod/ /hūṃ zhes pa 'dis bsngags pa'i ku sha rnams ba lang gi rna 23—75

ba'i tshad tsam byas nas rtse mo mdun du gug pa g.yas skor gyis thab la dgab par bya'o / /yang sor bcu gnyis pa'i rtswa skam po'i chun po thab kyi dbus su bzhag ste / de nas mchod sbyin kyi shing dang bud shing srog chags med pa thab las cung zad dma' bar byas nas shing bu ram gyi sgron me la sbar te oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ zhes 'don zhing thab kyi dbus su gzhug go/ /oṃ badzā na la ma hā byu ta dz+wa la swa sarba pā pa bhasgri ku ru sarba dubye hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dis bsngags te blugs gzar gyis mar gyi sreg blugs phul te sbar bar bya'o/ /ma sbar na rlung yab brdabs pas sbar bar bya'o / /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar sngon dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug gis rdo rje dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin zhing rang 'od kyi shes rab la 'khyud pa rin po che'i cod pan dang zla ba rdo rje can no/ /ram̐ las byung ba sbom zhing dkar ba de lta bu'i zhal gsum pa/ rang 'od kyi shes rab dang 'grogs shing phyag drug gis mi 'jigs pa dang bgrang phreng dang dbyu gu dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ral pa'i cod pan brtan par byas nas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes nas ni/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /ces pas gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pas dgug pa dang gzhug pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas thab tu ku sha'i gdan la bsnyen par byas te/ de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chu las ku sha'i rtse mos bsang gtor bya ba sngar bzhin dang zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa phul nas phye ma dang bral ba'i so rtsi dbul bar bya'o/ /23—76
