༄ / /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad pa/ 1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza tan+t+ra ni dā na gu rū pa de she nā khya ta/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad pa/3sna thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad par bya'o//de la rgyud 'di mgo mjug tu phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan par ston to/ /lnga gang zhe na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / sdud pa po phun sum tshogs pa dang / gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang /rgyud phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la bcom ldan 'das zhes bya bas ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ston to/ /bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes bya bas ni sdud pa phun sum tshogs pa ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes bya ba nas btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar kyis ni gnas phun sum 23—231

tshogs pa ston to/ /brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi zhes bya ba nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gang bar snang ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gyis ni 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ston to/ /'dis ci'i phyir rgyud phun sum tshogs pa ston zhe na/ ji skad brjod pas rgyud mgo mjug gi don rdzogs par 'dren pa'i phyir rgyud phun 7tshogs pa ston to/ /de la yang bcom ldan 'das zhes gong du bstan pa ni kun rdzob tu 'dod chags nas phrag dog gi bar gyi chos lnga po'i rang bzhin dang / sa bon gyi ngo bor gnas par bstan te/de'i ngo bo lhun gyis grub pa ni 'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas/ zhe sdang mi 'khrugs pa/ gti mug rnam par snang mdzad/ nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan/phrag dog gdon mi za bar grub pa/ sa bon ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'o/ /chos lnga po 'di dag las ye shes lngar yang sbyar te/ de la me long lta bu'i ye shes ni mi 'khrugs pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes ni snang ba mtha' yas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni gdon mi za bar grub pa'o/ /ci'i phyir gdon mi za bar grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bstan zhe na/ las kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni yang dag pa'i ye shes so/ /ye shes 'di dag las gzugs la sogs pa'i ngo bor gnas pa thams cad 2kyang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la rim par sbyar na gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas/ 'du byed gdon mi za bar grub pa/ rnam par shes pa mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /'di dag thams cad dam tshig gi ngo bor yang shes par bya ste/23—232

de la yang gzugs rnam gsum ni rnam par snang mdzad/ sgra rnam gsum ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ dri rnam gsum ni snang ba mtha' yas/ ro rnam gsum ni gdon mi za bar grub pa/ reg rnam gsum ni mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems lhun gyis grub pa las chos lnga po 'di dag skyed par byed de/lnga gang zhe na/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'o/ /de ji ltar skyed par byed ce na/de yang rim par dbye na/ sa'i khams ni sangs rgyas spyan/ chu'i khams ni mā ma tī/ me'i khams ni gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams ni 'phags ma sgrol ma/nam mkha'i khams ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /de yang 'bras bu rnam pa lnga skyed par byed de/ de gang zhe na/ zad par sar bsgoms pas hūṃni nam mkha' la 'chag pa dang gzhal med khang mngon par skyed par byed do/ /byang chub kyi sems rlan pa lta bu'i rang bzhin du bsgoms pas —ni 'jig rten thams cad chus yongs su gang bar spro ba dang bsdu ba nus par 'gyur ro/ /mer bsgoms pas ni 'bar ba'i rdzu 'phrul skyed par byed do/ /rlung gi khams su bsgoms pas ni yid kyi 'gro ba skyed par byed do/ /cenam mkha'i khams su bsgoms pas ni sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes skyed par byed do/ /'bras bu mdo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang mig la sogs pas 'phrul kyi mig la sogs pa skyed depa'i rgyur yang ston te/ de yang gang zhe na/ mig dang / rna ba dang /sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid do/ /de la mig ni sa'i snying po/rna ba ni phyag na rdo rje/ sna ni nam mkha'i snying po/ lce ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /lus ni sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ yid ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni 'di dag skyed par byed de/ sa'i snying pos 23—233

'phrul gyi mig /phyag na rdo rjes 'phrul gyi rna ba/ nam mkha'i snying pos 'phrul gyi sna/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos 'phrul kyi lce ste/ sems can sna tshogs la sgra sna tshogs kyis so so'i mos pa ji lta ba bzhin chos ston pa'o/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel bas lus kyi rdzu 'phrul dang yid kyi gzugs dang sprul pa skyed skyepar byed do/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rdo rje'i rdzu 'phrul yang skyed par byed do/ /yid rdo rje sems dpas ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / zag pa thams cad zad pa'i ye shes skyed byepar byed do/ /mnyam par spyor ba'i dus su 'phags pa gshin rje gshed lag pa gnyis te lcags kyu'i don / 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje —pad+mor zhugs pa ste zhags pa'i tshul / 'phags pa rta mgrin ni phyag rgya chen po dang mu dra gnyis zhal spyor ba ste be+egs sgrog gi don to/ /'phags pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las kyi phyir las kyi dus su bde ba chen po'i gnas gnyis mnyes par byed pa ste dril bu'i don to/ /de dag thams cad byang chub kyi sems las byung bar ston to / /4thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bskyed par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngar bsdus pa'i don gsal bar bstan nas/ phyis slob dpon gyi 5rgyud bshad par brtsam par bya'o / /de la 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba nas/ btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs so zhes pa'i bar dag gi don ni slob dpon gyi kyeman ngag gis bstan par bya ste/ e zhes pa 7dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ waṃ zhes pa ni phyag rgya chen po/ ma ni chos kyi phyag rgya/ yā ni las kyi phyag rgya/ khru 9kra zhes pa ni spro ba'i don to/ /e zhes pa ni gzungs ma'o/ /waṃ zhes bya ba ni byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ 'di'i dus na zhes pa ni 'di'i tshe na zhes bya bar sbyar/ yang 23—234

na sa ma ya zhes pa ni dus dang mi sbyar gyi/ 'di'i phyag rgya nyid la gnas so zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni bdud sde bzhi bcom pa dang /legs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i phyir yang bcom ldan 'das zhes bya'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i phyir yang bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa ni ji ltar skye ba bzhin skyes pa'i phyir yang de bzhin gshegs 1tshozhes pa'o/ /de la yang ji ltar skye zhe na/ pha ma gnyis thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i dbang gis pho mo phrad par gyur nas/ de nyid rnam par sbyangs nas yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro ba'i phyir na de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /yang na ji ltar 'ongs bzhin 'gro ba'i phyir yang de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /dper na zangs dang 'khar ba la sogs pa rdzas kyi dngos po gcig la chol zangs su byas pa'i dus na ni btsog par 'dzin cing mchil snabs 'e la sogs pa 'dor bar byed/ de la gzhong pa la sogs par byas na ni gtsang bar 'dzin cing / zas skom la sogs pa 'jog cing za bar byed/ de la sku gzugs la sogs pa byas pa'i dus na ni phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa'i las su byed do/ /de dang 'dra bar 'khor ba'i rgyu 'dod chags kyang chonyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i dus na ni smad cing spang bar bya ba yin la de nyid thabs dang shes rab kyi tshul du sbyor ba'i dus na rdo rje sems dpa'i skur grub par byed pa'i dga' ba'i longs spyod kyi gnas kyang yin la/ de ltar thabs dang shes rab zung du 'byel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi longs spyod goms pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid mngon par grub par byed do/ /de bzhin du 'dod chags nas phrag dog gi bar gyi chos lnga po 'di dag kyang dang po'i 23—235

tshul ltar spyad na ngan song gi rgyu yang yin/ de nyid rang bzhin rnam par dag par bsgoms na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i rgyu yang yin pas nyes par mi 'gyur te/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra mang du sbyar zhing bshad ci dgos te/ rgyud kyi don nges par bstan pa 'di yin no// //sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs so zhes bya ba la/ sku gsung thugs ni lus ngag yid do cog gi rang bzhin yang yin la / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yang yin pas de'i phyir sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /snying po ni sa bon te/rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs so zhes pa ni btsun mo ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dkyil zhes pa ni pad+mo ste de ni bzhugs par sbyar/de yang ji ltar bzhugs she na/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po ye shes kyi rang bzhin chu lta bu'i ngo bo zla ba lta bur dkar zhing dag pa'i tshul du bzhugs 3so/ /de la yang 'di skad ces pa nas btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs so zhes pa'i bar de dag rnam grangs gzhan du yang bstan par bya ste/ e ni chos kyi 'byung gnas/waṃ ni rdo rje ma ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ye shes kyi sa bon/ ya ni bskyod pa las kyi mtshan nyid/ shu 5kra ni 'byung ba'i don/ e ka ni ldan pa'i mtshan nyid / 'di'i dus na zhes bya ba ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i dges pa'i gnas bha ga bān ni bha ga'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i phyir/ bha ga bān zhes bya'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje zhes pa ni sa bon zla ba lta bu dang sbyar/ btsun mo'i dkyil na bzhugs 23—236

so zhes pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang phyug ma'i pad+ma'i gnas na bzhugs par ston to/ /bi dza ha ra'i sgras ni bzhugs pa'i don to/ /bzhugs so zhes pa'i sgras ni rnam par gnas so zhes pa'i don to/ /yang rnam grangs gzhan du yang bshad par bya ste—/ e khaṃ lhazhes pa ni 'dzin pa'i don te/ sdud par mdzad pa rdo rje chos kyis bsdus pa'o/ /de yang 'di skad ces bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes pa'i bar dag /bdag gis mngon sum du thos so zhes ston to/ /bdag gis zhes pa ni gzhan dang gzhan las brgyud pa lta bu ma yin pa'i don to/ /sa ma ya zhes pa'i sgra ni dus mtshon pa'o/ /'di ltar dus mtshon pa yang dus gsum la sogs pa dus nges par bstan pa ni ma yin no—/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni bdud bzhi bcom pa dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgu dang gsung dang thugs snying po rdo rje zhes pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi thugs kyi snying po'i sa bon ni rdo rje zhes pa ni mi phyed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /btsun mo zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i don to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'byung gnas de'i gnas na bzhugs so zhes bya ba de ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /skabs 'dir gzhan dag gis brgal ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa zhes bya bas chog mod/'di skad bdag gis thos pa dgos ched med de2/ de nas zhes bya ba dang rgyud ldan pa'am/ lhan cig ces byas na tshig 'byel cing bde ste/ de yang sbu'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu brjod na ni 'di 23—237

skad bdag gis thos pa zhes brjod pa'i rigs kyi/ da ltar bcom ldan 'das mngon sum tedu bzhugs pa'i dus su 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa 'di rigs pa ma yin no zhe na/ lan du rigs pa yin te/ rgyud thams cad las kyang 'di skad bdag gis thos so zhes 'byung la/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das so zhes ni rgyud gzhan gang las kyang ma gsungs so/ /kha cig gis 3snabargal ba/rgyud sdud par mdzad pa dag med do zhes gzhan dag smra'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rgyud 'di dag gnyis su med par gnas pa'i phyir ro zhe'o/ /lan du rgyud 'di dag las phyir gyur pa gzhan dag ci ste 'dri ba po zhig med na rgyud 'di dag ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur zhes rnam par rtog ste/ de dag bsal rngo 7ba'i phyir 'di skad bdag gis thos so zhes smos sozi/ /brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhes pa ni rgya gar gyi sgra dang sbyar na a phyi la pa ni grangs bstan pa yin la/nas bkag na grangs las 'das pa'i don du bstan pa yin te/ de'i phyir brjod du med pa zhes bya'o/ /yang brjod du med pa zhes bya ba yeni gzugs dang yon tan brjod du med pa ste/ de'i phyir brjod du med pa'i brjod du med pa zhes bya'o/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 6rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa zhes pa ni rab tu mang po'i don te grangs med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes pa la byang chub ni phyag rgya/ sems dpa' ni 'dod pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni gnyis su med par 7gnas pa'i don to/ /sems dpa' chen po zhes pa ni bde ba chen po'i ye shes la gnas so zhes bya ba'i don te/ de'i phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /de lta bas na chos kyi 'byung gnas la gnas so/ /de yang 23—238

su'i thad na bzhugs she na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor na bzhugs so/ /de la gong du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phran dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bsdus pa'i don du bstan gyi/ gang dang gang bzhugs pa bstan pa'i phyir 'dir so so'i mtshan yang smos so/ /de la dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang zhes bya ba thog mar ci'i phyir smos she na/ dam tshig gis ༄1lha rnams mnyes pa'i rgyur byed pa'i phyir gtsor smos te dang por bstan pa yin no/ /dam tshig nyid ji lta bu zhe na rnam pa gnyis te/phyi dang nang ngo / /de la phyi gang zhe na/ 'jig rten pa'i bsrung bar bya ba rnams so/ /nang gi gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa bza' ba'o /de ltar dam tshig bsrungs nas sku bsgrub pa'i phyir sgu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba smos so/ /gang gis sku grub pa dang / tshig kyang dgos te/ sku dang gsung mi phyed par bstan pa'i phyir te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du mngon par sprul nas gnas par bstan to/ /de'i phyir gsung rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes smos so/ /de ltar tshig 'grub nas sems dpyod par byed de/ de la sems ni dngos po thams cad dang rang bzhin gyis bral bar yang mkhyen la/ thams cad dang mi gnyis par yang mkhyen pas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du mngon par sprul nas gnas par bstan te/ de'i phyir thugs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes smos so/ /de la sku gsung thugs ting nge 'dzin med par sangs rgyas kyi sku gnyis su med par mngon par mi 'grub pas/de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes 23—239

smos so/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin thob nas gang gis sems mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ba de rgyal bar bstan pa yin te/ de'i phyir rgyal ba rdo rje zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snesmos so/ /gang gis sku gsung thugs dang phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs lha mo dang ldan pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyal ba de thams cad sa la sogs pa med par gzugs bskyed ༄ —par mi nus pas de'i phyir sa rdo rje zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du bstan te/ de'i phyir sa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snyesmos so/ /da ni chos kyi chu'i char 'be+ebs pas chu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya bar bstan to/ /de'i phyir chu rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /de ltar chu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar bstan nas me las thams cad 'grub par bstan pa'i phyir me rdo rje zhes bya bar bstan to/ /de ltar me rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar bstan nas/thams cad du 'gro ba'i gzugs lhun gyis grub par bstan pa'i phyir/ rlung rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar bstan to/ /de ltar rlung rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar bstan nas/ sgrib pa med par snang ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' rdo rje zhes bya ba'i chobyang chub sems dpa'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon par sprul pa'i phyir nam mkha' rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de ltar nam mkha' rdo rje zhes bya ba mngon par bsgrubs nas/da ni gnyis su med pa la dmigs pa lta bas chog mi shes pa'i gzugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin du bstan te/ de'i phyir gzugs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de ltar gzugs ji lta bu yang bstan nas/ gnyis su 23—240

med pa'i sgras sems can thams cad kyi sems tshim par byed pa'i sgra bzhin dang /gang dag gis sgrar brjod pa de dag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du gnas par bstan te/ de'i phyir sgra rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de ltar pad+ma dang rdo rje la sogs pa'i sgra bstan nas/ da ni bdag nyid rab tu tshim pa myong bar bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon par sprul nas gnas par bstan te/ de'i phyir dri rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de ltar dri rdo rjes bdag dang gzhan gyi sems tshim par byed pa bstan nas/ da ni dam tshig dang zhal mi gnyis pa sprad pa'i ro myang 1snabar bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du gnas par bstan te/ de'i phyir ro rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar smos so/ /de ltar ro rdo rje zhes bya bar bstan nas/ dbang po gnyis reg pa'i bde ba bstan pa'i phyir reg rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de ltar de yan chad du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga mdor bstan pa'am yang na 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga byang chub sems dpa'i tshul du bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar reg rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar bstan nas/ rdo rje dang pad+mor ldan pa las byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i dus na rnal 'byor pas shes par bya ba ni/'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /gnyis ka min pa'ang mi dmigs so/ /zhes bstan pa khong du chud par bya zhing byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba na bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings yin no zhes nga rgyal bskyed par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' smos so/ /de la sogs pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjob/ du drad pa /zhes bya ba nas / byang zub sem sa dpe ra rtsem sa dpa 'a 23—241

chen po rnams dang zhes pa'i bar dag ni gong du bstan pas 'dir ma smos so/ /de ltar 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bstan nas/ da ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ston te/ de yang tshad ji tsam zhe na/ nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa zhes 'byung mod kyi/ re zhig 'dir mi bskyod pa la sogs pa gtso bo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /de la bdag gi 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog rnams kyi rang bzhin bstan te/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang dag zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems de'i 1snango bor gnas par bstan to/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang dag gti mug dang bcas pa rnams la de'i ngo bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi tshul du gnas par bstan to/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang dag nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sems kyi tshul du rin chen 'byung ldan de'i ngo bor gnas par bstan to/ /tshad med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang dag 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems snang ba mtha' yas de'i rang bzhin las byung bar bstan pa'i phyir tshad med pa rdo rje zhes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa smos so/ /gdon mi za ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang phrag dog dang ldan pa'i sems de'i ngo bor gdon mi za ba'i rdo rje gnas par bstan to/ /de dag 2la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par bstan pa 'di dag ni phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs lhun gyis grub par bstan te/ rang gi lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag byang chub kyi sems las rang grub pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag rgyud las gtsor smos te bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems 23—242

dpa' nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par bstan pa de dag ni chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par sprul pas khyad par sprul pa'i don du bstan pa'o/ /de la nam mkha' thams cad ces pa ni chos kyi 'byung gnas/ dbyings zhes pa ni sa bon/mnyam zhes pa ni khyab pa/ bstan pa zhes pa ni gsungs pa'i don to tsho/ /'di dag gsungs pa ni chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dkyil na sa bon gyi tshul du phyag rgya thams cad kyi bhe /skur khyab par gnas par bstan pa'o/ /yang na nam mkha' thams cad ces pa ni lha mo bzhi dang de bzhin gshegs par ldan pa phyag rgya chos kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje dang mi gnyis par chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du thams cad sprul nas bzhugs so/ /mang por smos ci dgos te don mdor bstan pa ni 'di dag yin no zhe na/ de la sngar smos pa 'di dag ni byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsdus te bsgrub pa'i gzhung gis bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar du skyed kyido/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das nyid bskyed par ma zad kyi sngags pa nyid kyang 'di lta bu'i tshul kyis mngon par bsgrub 4bo/ /rgyud 'di nyid kyang 'phags pa nyid kyi sku dang mnyam pa'i tshul du byin gyis brlabs 5par shes par bya'o / /yang na de bzhin nyid rnam par bsgoms la de las snang ba'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de skyes pas yig 'bru'i rgyur 'gyur te sngags kyi 'bru skyed par 'gyur ro/ /de las lus kyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das rab tu 'grub par 'gyur te/ de yang mtshan dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bar ldan pa pad+ma'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i nam mkha'i phyogs na rgyud las smos pa'i lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi yan lag dang nying lag tu blos rnam par rtog ste/ de yang ji ltar rnam par rtog ce na/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog de kho na 23—243

nyid rnam pa lnga dang bdag ldan par rnam par rtog par byed do/ /'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas/ zhe sdang mi bskyod pa/ gti mug rnam par snang mdzad/nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan/ phrag dog gdon mi za bar grub pa/ sa bon rnam par snang mdzad chen po ste/ de las rnam pa lnga po 'di dag tu 'gyur bar ston no/ /'dod chags la sogs pa 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur rnam par brtag go/ /de nas yang ye shes kyi tshul du so sor dbye na/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mi bskyod pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan/ so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes snang ba mtha' yas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes gdon mi za bar grub pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam par snang mdzad gang bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs 'di gti mug ste rnam par snang mdzad/ gang bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi bdag nyid kyi tshul du gnas pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ gang dus gsum du chags pa'i 'du shes 'byung ba'i rang bzhin ni snang ba mtha' yas/ gang phrag dog mngon par 'du byed pa'i rang bzhin ni gdon mi za bar grub pa'o/ /gang zhe sdang ba ni mi bskyod pa ste rnam par shes pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'dod chags la sogs pa chos ji snyed pa thams cad kyi bdag po'i 1rang bzhin du bdag gyur par rnam par brtag go/ /gzugs rnam pa gsum kyi tshul du gnas pa rnam par snang mdzad/ sgra rnam pa gsum gyi tshul du gnas pa rin chen 'byung ldan/ dri rnam pa gsum gyi tshul du gnas pa ni snang ba mtha' yas/ ro rnam pa gsum gyi tshul du gnas pa ni ༷ gdon mi za bar grub pa / reg rnam pa gsum gyi tshul du gnas pa ni mi bskyod pa'o / /de ltar rnam par brtags nas yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi ji ltar rnam 23—244

par brtag ce na/ de la tshosa'i khams ni sangs rgyas spyan/ me'i khams ni gos dkar mo/ chu'i khams ni mā ma tī/ rlung gi khams ni 'phags ma sgol ma /nam mkha'i khams ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /de la mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin yang 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ mig gi rnam par shes pa ni sa'i snying po/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni phyag na rdo rje/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ni nam mkha'i snying po/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ 'phrul gyi mig la sogs pa yang rnam par dag go/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi dus su blos 'di ltar shes par bya ste/lag pa gnyis ni gshin rje gshed kyi rang bzhin te yongs su 'dzin pa'i dus na lcags kyu'i don/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje pad+mor gnas pa'i dus na zhags pa'i tshul du bsam mo/ /'phags pa rta mgrin ni zhal sprod pa'i dus su lcags sgrog ste/ tshems kyi sgros bsdams pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las kyi rang bzhin te/ las kyi dus na bde ba chen po la gnas pa'am mnyes par byed pa ste dril bu'i don to/ /sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas de ltar rnam par rtogs par bya'o/ /'di dag thabs chen po ye shes las grub par shes par bya'o//rgyud las 'khor sems dpa' gang dag gsungs pa mngon par 'byung ba'i dus na lus chothams cad kyi yan lag dang nying lag lta bu blos rnam par dbye bar bya ba ste/de la dam tshig rdo rje dang / sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang / ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dang / rgyal ba rdo rje dang / sa rdo rje dang / chu rdo rje dang / me rdo rje dang /rlung rdo rje dang / nam mkha' rdo rje dang / gzugs rdo rje dang / sgra rdo rje 23—245

dang / dri rdo rje dang / ro rdo rje dang / reg rdo rje dang / chos kyi dbyings rdo rje dang / rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje dang / mi 'khrugs pa rdo rje dang /rin chen 'byung ldan rdo rje dang / snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje dang / gdon mi za bar grub pa rdo rje dang stehūṃ/ 'di dag thams cad lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag tu blos rim pa bzhin du gtso bo'i skur rnam par brtag go/ /de la dam tshig gi rang bzhin ni bdud rtsi dang ldan pa'i ngo bo ste/ de bas na dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /de la sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba la sku ni chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku'o/ /gsung gi rang bzhin ni gsang sngags thams cad ston pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa la rjes su chags pa'i don ni ting nge 'dzin to/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa las dgyes pa 'byung ba ni rgyal ba'o/ /sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las skur 'grub ste / sa ni gzhal med khang gi rang bzhin no/ /chu ni gsher ba'o/ /me ni cho 'phrul lo/ /rlung ni brkyang bskum byed pa'o/ /nam mkha' ni lus thams cad gsal bar byed pa'o/ /gzugs ni mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'o/ /sgra ni rdo rje dang pad+mar ldan pa'o/ /dri ni yid tshim par byed pa'o/ /ro ni zhal gnyis myong bar byed pa'o/ /reg pa ni dbang po gnyis bdar bar byed pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bde ba chen po la gnas pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa ni zhe sdang / rnam par snang mdzad ni gti mug /rin chen 'byung ldan ni nga rgyal/ gdon mi za bar grub pa ni phrag dog /snang ba mtha' yas ni 'dod chags te/ thams cad kyang lus la gnas par shes nas gtso bo 'di dag la sogs pa spro bar mdzad do/ /zhal du zhugs nas dbang 23—246

po'i lam du byung ste chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dkyil du bdag po'i sku dang ldan par gnas te/ de yang lus thams cad rnam par zhu nas sa bon gyi tshul du bde ba chen po'i lus la gnas par rnal 'byor pas mthong ngo / /sgrub pa thams cad kyi thabs kyi rim gyis byebadag nyid dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mthong ste 'di nyid phyag rgya chen po'o/ /rdo rje pad+mor ldan pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /bde ba chen po ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /gnyis kyi las gang yin pa de nyid las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+mor mnyam par sbyor ba yid kyis mthong nas 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes mngon pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /yang na bde ba chen po la gnas te/ byang chub kyi sems sa bon gyi tshul du lus thams cad la khyab ste de la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog dang / gzugs dang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang yid la sogs pa lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du byas nas/ 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbus su'ang dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par spros nas/rnam par mi rtog par snye'agyur te gnas so/ /de ltar lhun gyes grub nas sprul pa'i 'khor lo skor bar byed do/ /de yang sngon kyi stobs kyis sems can kyi don byed par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rtag tu dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi tshul du gnas te/ thams cad bde ba chen po ye shes kyi tshul du bsgom par bya'o/ /gzugs rnam gsum ni mig gi dbang po la rnam par snang mdzad kyi tshul du yongs su thim mo/ /sgra rnam gsum ni rna ba'i dbang po la 23—247

rin chen 'byung ldan gyi tshul du yongs su thim mo/ /dri rnam gsum ni sna'i dbang po la snang ba mtha' yas kyi tshul du 3yongs su thim mo/ /ro rnam gsum ni lce'i dbang po la gdon mi za ba'i tshul du yongs su thim mo/ /reg rnam gsum ni lus kyi dbang po la mi bskyod pa'i tshul du yongs su thim mo/ /bdag gi lus sam 2gang dag gi lus dang ldan pa de dag 'di ltar rnam par gnas te/ de la 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin snang ba mtha' yas te 'di ltar nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o—/ /gang dag zhe sdang dang ldan pa de dag ni mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /bdag gam bdag gi lus la bad kan ltar gnas pa de dag ni gti mug ste rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 2/nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /rgyas pa ni no pe ka dag las smos te/ 'dir ni sa 'dzin tsam du smos par zad do—/ /bza' ba la sogs pa yang 'dir ma smos so/ /de nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa yang rim bzhin du bstan to/ /byang chub kyi sems rang bzhin bskyed 4pa mdo tsam zhig bskyed par bya ste/ de bas na 'di ltar brtag par bya'o/ /bdag sngon pha ma phrad pa'i sa bon las bskyed pa bzhin du bdag skyes te/ de bas na bdag ni grub pa'o zhes sku 'ba' zhig dran par bya'o/ /ji ltar grub pa dang rim gyis bstan te/ pha gang yin pa de bdag 5gi lha'o/ /ma gang yin pa de rigs kyi lha mo'o/ /de'i lus kyi 'dod chags gang yin pa de snang ba mtha' yas / zhe sdang gang yin pa de mi 'khrugs 6pa/ gti mug gang yin pa de rnam par snang mdzad/ nga rgyal gang yin pa de rin chen 'byung ldan/ phrag dog gang yin pa de gdon mi za bar grub pa/ gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems sa bon gang yin pa de ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po ste/ de bas de dag mngon 23—248

par 'byung ngo / /de nas yang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bstan te/ pha dang ma'i me long lta bu'i ye shes ni 2mi bskyod pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes ni snang ba mtha' yas bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes ni don yod grub pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gzugs la sogs pa de dag thams cad gzugs so zhes dran par bya'o/ /pha dang ma'i gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad/tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas/ 'du byed don yod grub pa/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ pha dang ma'i lus kyi sa ni sangs rgyas spyan/ chu ni rgyal ba'i yum/ me ni gos dkar mo/ rlung ni 'phags ma sgrol ma/ nam mkha' ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ yang gzhan yang dran par bya ste/ mig sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /lus sgrib pa rnam par sel ba/ yid rdo rje sems dpa' pha dang ma kun du sbyor ba'i lcags kyu gshin rje gshed/ rdo rje pad+mar zhugs pa zhags pa ste gzhan gyis mi thub pa/'ching ba lcags sgrog ste rta mgrin/ las sam sa bon 'byung ba'i dus na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ de'i dus na bdag zhugs so/ /zhugs pa'i dus na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'/ mig rna ba sna lce lus yid la sogs pa sa bon rnam par snang mdzad chen pos bskyed de/ bde ba chen po la gnas pa'i dus na'o/ /de bas na bdag dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin no/ /gang dag rdzas dgu'i dngos po las skyes pa'i dus na dgu po de dag rnam par bsgom par 23—249

bya'o / /de la rdzas dgu ni 'di dag ste/ gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes pa sa chu me rlung nam mkha'/ mig rna ba sna lce lus yid la sogs pa ba sru'i lkubu ga thams cad nas byang chub kyi sems las rngo /mngon par sprul te/chos kyi dbyengs kyi rang bzhin du bdag skyes pas/ de'i phyir bdag chos kyi dbyings so/ /de ltar shes par bya ste/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi thams cad du rtag par bsgom par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems las de lta bu'i tshul du skye ba'am—/ yang na snang ba mtha' yas kyi tshul du skyes pa'o/ /ye shes tsam du shes par byas nas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du bdag bsgom par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa cerim gyis bstan par bya ste/ 'dod chags 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin gyis med do/ /de bas na zhe sdang khyazhe sdang gi — 7rang bzhin gyis med do/ /de bzhin du gti mug 3gti mug gi rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs so/ /nga rgyal yang shin tu rang bzhin med do/ /de bzhin du phrag dog kyang rang bzhin med do/ /sa ni rdul phra mo'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /chu yang de bzhin no/ /me dang rlung dang nam mkha' yang 'du shes tsam du brtag par bya'o/ /gzugs dang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa la sogs pa yang stong ngo / /de bzhin du mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid la sogs pa yang stong ngo / /gang gi byedus na de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems skyes 9pa de ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /de lta bas na bdag rang bzhin gyis grub pa ste/ skye — ba dang 'jig pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'gro ba dang gnas pa la sogs pa thams cad kyang bdag grub pa bzhin no bar shes par bya'o/ /rang 23—250

bzhin gyis kun 'di ltar lhun gyis grub pa'i sgyu ma stong pa'i sbyor gzhi 1mgon po thams cad mkhyer pa'i bdag go zhes 'di ltar shes par byas na/ rab tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/231 khyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8 nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel bzhugs so// 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ra / /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza tan+d+ra ni dā na gu rū pa de she tsā khya ta/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad pa/ ༷ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/232 lku〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 sum/ bye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 las/233 /—sna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga / 4 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉donas/ ḍa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol gnas/ ci 5 〈〈pe 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉rabaskyed/234 1shā 〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉〉baba'i/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma 'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis—/ ྅〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkani/ ldu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phro/ she7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7/235 she7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7pa/ bye 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 rnams/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang /236 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthugs/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉byu/237 /17〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes//23/ /7〈〈snar 〉sngagasum/ bye 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉stag/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giso 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ du 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gigi/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/239 1/〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉med/ rngo 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉girgyur byed pa'i/24༷ 13〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7zhes/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7zhes/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7byaba'i/241 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshang / ri — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7par/242 rmye〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉8 ni/ — 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dag243 lku〈〈pe 〉skosar 〉〉te/ rngo bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/ ༄ 〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlab/244 hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅/ bye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ni/ bye — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa/23byed251

245 she〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pas/ (khya〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wam/ khu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi ni/ bya〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉kyi/246 nye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waste/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉5nga /247 she〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rims kyis/ ldu/〈〈spa 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/248 sna 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadu/ 67〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 gang dag gi lus sam/ zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ri du/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ thu〈〈snar 〉stanag ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshogabrug249 nyu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu ye shes/25༷ sna 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sru/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi las/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/5〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wan zhe snang / kye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wagi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉wagati mug bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gis / 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskyed/ co〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyo/251 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi/bsdu/ da'abras7 (shā mig—

༄ga /dpal bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1 ༄spro/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po sangs rgyas kun ngo bo/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rgyal ba'i gtso/ /lha mo'i tshogs bcas bde chen la/ /dad pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal te/ /dpal ldan gsang 'dus rgyud 'di yi/ /don rtogs gsal bar bya ba dang / /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di bshad par bya/ /dang por sngags pas nges par ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyes byas te/ /dbang bskur gnang ba thob nas ni/ /de nas sgrub pa brtsam — par bya/ /dkyil 'khor du ni zhugs pa dang / /de bzhin gsang nyid shes pa dang / /kun byed thams cad za ba yis the tshom med par dngos grub thob/ /gtso la mi phyed dad pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog blo ldan zhing / /dam tshig sdom la gnas pa ni/ /bram ze bsad na'ang 4 'grub par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni dman pa dang / /dam tshig rnam 23—253

—par spangs pa dang / /gsang ba de nyid mi shes pas/ /bsgrubs kyang cung zad 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /sha khrag dri chen rdo rje chu/ /lnga pa sems ni 'byung ba ste/ /sngags pas cho gas byen brlabs nas/ /nyin gcig bzhin du bza' bar bya/ /sbyang sbar de bzhin rtogs byas la/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes bya'i phyir/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bza' bar bya/ /hūṃ zhes pas ni kun du sbyaranye/ /byedazhes pas ni rtogs par bya/ /oṃ gyis 'bar bar bsgom byas pa/ /'di ni dam tshig dam pa'o/ /glang chen rta dang sha chen dang / /ba lang khyi sha mchog yin te/ /zas phyir 'di dag bza' bar bya/ /gzhan ni bza' bar mi bya'o/ /sha rnams dag ni ma rnyed na/ /kun la bsgom zhing rnam par brtag /rdo rje'i spyor ba 'di dag gis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /bza' ba'am yang na btung ba ste/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ci bza' ba/ /dri chu sha yi spyor ba ste/ /cho ga ji bzhin brtag par bya/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa/ /rang lus ngag yid rdo rje yi/ /snying gar ye shes dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje mchog 'dzin cod pan du'o/ /dam tshig rdo rje lce rtser ni/ /hūṃ las rdo rjer bsgom byas la/ /s+dzadang oṃ gyi sbyor ba yis/ /zos na byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 'gyur ba/ /dam tshig mchog ces bya ba ste/ /mchog gi dngos grub thams cad byed/ /rtag par gzhan nas dbrog pa dang / /rmad du byung bas gsod pa dang / /'dod chags rdo rje nyid spyor ba2/ /'di ni sdom pas bsdams pa'o/ /dam bca' brtul zhugs dka' spyod pa/ /bsten pas 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /'dod 23—254

pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /slong mo'i zan zas mi bzlas shing / /slong rmyel dga' bar mi bya ste/ /yan lag mi gnyis sngags bzlas la/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun spyad do/ /lus dang ngag yid bder gnas na/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi 'gyur zhing / /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu bsreg /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog spyod pas/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod kun brten bye snan/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog thob 'gyur/ /chags pa'i ye shes rtag bsgrubs pas/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga brten 7zhing //byang chub dpa' bo chags pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mnyes par bya /gzugs sgra dri la sogs pa la/ /smad pa dag tu mi bya ste/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal de nyid ni/ /thams cad du ni yang dag gnas/ /gzugs sgra ro dang reg gi rnams / /de bzhin rab 'bring tha ma ste/ /khyad par rnam gsum shes byas nas / /rdo rje sems la mchod par chobya/ /sngags pas rnam pa 'di dag gis/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung dābyas na/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'di dag gis/ /rdo rje gsum nyid thob par 'gyur/ /gal te gti mug can gyis 'das/ /de la dngos grub mi 'byung zhing / /rims dang dug dang nad bgegs kyis/ /bsad nas sems cad dmyal bar 'gro/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /byin gyis rlob par mi mdzad cing / /me tog bdug spos la sogs rnams / /phul yang bzhes par mi mdzad do/ /'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal zhing / /pha rol tu yang dmyal bar 'gro/ /dam tshig spyod pa nyams pa yis—/ /gti mug can gyis grub mi 'thob/ /sngar smos sdom la gnas pa ni/ /23—255

rtag par mi phyed brtul zhugs kyis/ /lus dang ngag yid rdo rje yi/ /sgrub rmyepa dag ni brtsam par bya/ /nags tshal chen po'i phyogs dag dang / /dben pa chen po'i gnas dag dang / /ri bo ril pya sul rnams su ni/ /dngos grub rtag tu thob par 'gyur/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung gis/ /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin du/ /gnas nas gnas bsrung rnam par bsam/ /gzugs chen 'bar ba 'jigs byed pa'i 1/ /khro bo bcu dag phyung nas ni/ /hūṃ las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i steng / /smad ni rtse mor rnam par bsam / /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor phyogs rnams su/ /rim pa bzhin du kun du bsam/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig pa'i phyir/ /gnod mjes bka' stsal phur bus gdab/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /dbyar gyi sprin dpung 4lta bu ste/ /bskal pa'i me dpung bzhin du 'bar/ /g.yas brkyang bar ni rab tu gnas/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer dmar ba'i spyan/ /zhal gsum mche gcigs rnam par sgyur/ /phyag gnyis hūṃ gi rgya bcings te/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yas gnyis lcags kyu ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon gnyis dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin/ /'di 'dra'i 5gzugs ni bsam byas nas / /rang gis de la bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha trehūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ/kṛ1 pa ya kṛt+tha 7pa 3hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān9/ bir+ya rā dzā ya hūṃ phaṭa/khro bo'i rgyal po 'di dag gis/ /bgegs ni kun nas rnam par 'jig /blo ldan rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du phur kun gdab/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal chen po/ /rdo rje phur bu nyid gnas pa/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lte ba man chad cha rnams rgo/ /rtse mo 23—256

lta bur rnam par bsgomalku/ /ro stod khro bo lta bu nyid/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /bgegs kyi tshogs la 'og tu gzigs/ /de yi sngags 'di brjod bya ste/ /rdo rje phur bu nges btab na/ /bgegs lus shin tu mi g.yo'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba dubye t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ kri la ya kri la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dhā ro adz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje tho ba phyag bsnams mchog /gnod mdzes rgyal po rnam par bsgom shi / /hūṃ brjod 'bar ba'i lta bas ni/ /bgegs rnams thams cad phur bus gdab/ /phyogs rnams kun du rdo rje'i me/ /rnam par 'phro ba rnam bsams te/ /ma rungs pa ni tshig bsams na/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs mtshams phur bus btab nas ni/ /steng 'og yang dag byin gyis brlab1/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom pa ni/ /srid gsum rang bzhin med pa ste/ /dngos po med pa bsgom pa'i dngos/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /dngos po brtan g.yo la sogs kun/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis stong 4gyur nas/ /cho ga 'di yi spyor ba yis/ /ye shes sa ni byin gyis brlab5/ /byang chub rdo rje dmigs nas ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dug nas/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab pa yi/ /lha mo mā ma khri ni bsam/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbus gnas pa/ /dung dang kun da zla 'dra yi / /ye shes bdud rtsi las byung ba/ /sa yi khams ni byin gyis brlab/ /chu zheng dpag tshad bye ba ste/ /dang la rang bzhin dri ma med/ /'od zer rnam lngas kun du 'khrigs/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can gyi gnas / /de dbus zlo ni gnas pa la/ /gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba yi/ /23—257

sangs rgyas kun gyi gzhal med khang / /'khor los 1sgyur ba bsgom par bya /las kyi rdo rje stan nyid du/ /shes rab ldan pas de'i 'og bsam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyi pho brang ngo / /rin chen bzhi dngos mchod rten ni/ /'od zer phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /ye shes rgya mtsho dus gsum gyi/ /gnas su de ni rnam par bsam/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo rgyan bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dril bu dar dpyangs 'phen la sogs/ /sgo khyud kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /grwa mtshams dag ni thams cad du / /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /zla gam chun 'phyang gis brgyan pa/ /nyi ma zla la sogs pas brgyan/ /bla re bras pas mdzes gyur cing / /na bza' phreng ba sogs kyis brgyan/ /thig skud bzhi ni yongs btab pas/ /ka ba mchog brgyad kun du gnas/ /de dbus 'khor lo dmigs bya ba/ /kun nas yongs su zlum po ste/ /mdor na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rang gi gnas su rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje lha mo bzhi rnams kyang / /'khor lo'i grwar ni rnam par bsgom/ /gshin rje gshed sogs sgor dmigs te/ /sa snying la sogs bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /sems kyi rdo rje rang bdag nyid/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lta bu ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas/ /lus dang ngag yid rdo rje yi/ /mtshan nyid dam pa'i don nyid de/ /tshul bzhin rnal 'byor pas dpyad nas/ /sngags 'di rab tu brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ nam mkha' bzhin du blta bar bya/ /nam mkha' bstan du med pa ltar/ /bdag nyid rang bzhin med mthong nas/ /yi ge'i rnam pa bsgom par bya/ /bla 'og dbus ni 23—258

rim bzhin du'o/ /bdag nyid yi ge 'bru gsum gzugs/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus nyid du/ /kha dog gsum du bskyed nas ni/ /nyi zla pad+ma yang dag gnas/ /oṃ yisahūṃ/ dang ba'i zla ba 'dra bar ni/ /yi ge 'bru gsum zhu bar brtag /ye shes 'od zer rnam 'phros pas/ /rgyud drug gnas pa'i sems can dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bsdu ba'i sbyor bas kun bsdus nas/ /rang bzhin med par mos pa yis/ /byang chub sems la gzhug par bya/ /oṃ dhas+thā dh+wa tu badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ byang chub sems de kun du dag /dri med zla ba lta bur gnas/ /kun bsnyus bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /gzugs kyi ngo bor rnam par bsgom/ /sngags kyi sku ni mthar phyin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin dag /phung po khams su rnam bsams te/ /skye mched la sogs rnams kyis 1brgyan/ /gzugs kyi phung po rang bzhin du/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu gnas/ /tshor ba dkon mchog dpal dang ni/ /'du shes su ni snang mtha' yas/ /'du byed thams cad gdon mi za/ /rnam par shes su mi bskyod gnas/ /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags/ /oṃ swā saṃ hā hūṃ/ sa yi khams ni rnam bsams pa/ /phyi dang nang gi brtan pa ste/ /grub —par spyan ni bsam 5byas na/ /sra ba lta bur byin gyis rlob/ /chu khams mā ma khrir bsams ༄ pa/ /khu ba khrag ni nyid kyi rgyu/ /lus ngag sems zhes brjod pa la/ /gang ba nyid du rnam par gnas/ /me yi khams su rab sbyor ba/ /gos dkar mor ni blta bar bya/ /kun du mchog rab 'bar ba ste/ /de ni 'bar ba lta bur 'byung / /rlung gi khams kyi rang bzhin du/ /blo dang ldan pas sgrol ma 23—259

bsam / /de ni rlung lnga tsho'abyung ba ste/ /de bzhin yid kyi 'go ba 'grub/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin du/ /kun du bzang mo rab tu brtag /nam mkha' de yi spyor bas ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ /phung po khams kyi bye brag ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bar gnas/ /de ltar khams nyid bsam byas na/ /de ni kun du tshim par 'gyur/ /mo ha ra ti/ dwo ṣa — ra ti/ rā ga ra ti/ badz+ra ra —ti/ mig dang rna ba sna dang ni/ /lce dang lus dang yid dag tu/ /sa yi snying po la sogs sems/ /skye mched dag tu rnam par bsgom/ /r+ghaṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ haṃ oṃ/ nang gi skye mched rnams su ni/ /sa yi snying po la sogs gnas/ /phyi yi skye mched rang bzhin du/ /gzugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas/ /sa snying la sogs sngags rnams ni/ /rdo rje can gyi rgyud las gsungs/ /'di dag rnams ni ma gsungs phyir/ /gzugs la sogs pa ma bris so/ /phyi yi longs spyod kyis mchod phyir/ /gzugs sgra dag tu rab tu gnas/ /byin gyi rlabs 4kyis byin brlabs nas/ /'dod pa lnga ni spyad par bya/ /gzugs ni mig gi spyod yul gnas/ /sgra ni rna ba'i gnas su gnas//dri ni sna dang mtshungs ldan te/ /ro ni lce la rab tu gnas/ /reg ni lus kyi 5bde bar gnas/ /phyi yi skye mched nyid dag ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gshin rje gshed po lag pa g.yas/ /gzhan kyis mi thub g.yon pa ste/ /kha la rta mgrin bsgom par bya/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rdo rje la'o / /ya mān+ta kṛta6/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta/ pad+mān+ta kṛta3/ bisprun+ta kṛta8 /de ltar don kun rab zhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag gtso bo ni/ /bskyed nas byin gyis brlab bya ste/ /tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba gdab/ /23—260

spyi bo'i dbus gyur bsam pa ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba ste/ /der ni oṃ dkar 'od ldan pa'i/ /'od zer lnga ni 'phro ba'o/ /de las lha mo rnams 'phro ba/ /bdag po'i 1rab tu spyor ba ste/ /spyan ni rnam par bsam bya ba/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar ro/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rnam bsams pa bar snang khams ni gang bar gnas/ /de dbus bdag por bsam bya zhing / /bdag gi mdun na gnas par ro/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /sngags pa de yis bcol ba ni/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis gnyis brjod/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng rdunyid byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms te/ /deng nyid byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /spyan dang thabs cig ldan par ni/ /rtag par rnam par bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin zhugs par mos byas la/ /phung po lnga ni byin gyis brlab / /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku ni gang / /phung po lnga la rab tu gang / /sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin lce dbus pad+ma la/ /a las rdo rje 'dod chags te/ /rab zhugs de la gsol gdab cing / /rdo rje dag tu byin kyis brlab/ /chos kyi ngag lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng nyid byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms te/ /deng nyid byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung 23—261

gis mdzad du gsol/ /lce ni 'phro bar rnam 1bsgoms te/ /rang ngag chos rnams kun gyi gnas/ /gsung dbyangs thams cad rnam dag dang / /chos kyi ngag tu byin gyis brlab/ /ngag de rdo rje chos kyi 3ni/ /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de bzhin du/ /chos 'chad lta bur 'gyur bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra swa bhā wa yi ko3haṃ/ snying gi zla ba la dmigs pa/ /kha dog mthing shun 4lta bu yi/ /hūṃ zhes pa yi rdo rje sems/ /'od zer rnam lnga shin tu 'bar/ /sngar smos pa yi rim pa yis/ /rdo rje sems la gsol btab nas/ /de ni zhugs par bsgom byas te/ /sems rgo byin kyis brlab par bya/ /dpal ldan sems ni rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /snying la dpal be'u bsam pa ni/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /'od zer lngas 'khrigs 5lta bu ni/ /nga rgyal bskyed pas sbyar bar bya/ /kun du bzang po'i sems ni gang / /gsang dbang gi ni blo ldan pa/ /bdag dang de dang 'dra ba'i sems/ /rdo rje 'chang 'drar gyur par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ dbang bskur gong ma bzhin bsgom pa/ /chen po'i rgyu mthun la sogs yin/ /mi bskyod dbu brgyan 6sangs rgyas bzhin7/ /lhag ma rang gi bdag dbang bskur/ /sku yi dbang phyug mi bskyod pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug thugs kyi dbang / /dbu rgyan de bzhin 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar rim pas dbang bskur nas/ /rang gi snying po 23—262

'od zer gyis/ /shes rab ma yi dkyil du ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa thim byas te/ /ba spu'i 7bu ga las byung ba'i/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs 'od ni/ /gzhal yas khang nas byung nas su/ /bar snang dkyil du khyab pa yis/ /bdag dang thub dbang mchod byas te/ /mchod dang mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ rigs gsum rigs lnga brgya rnams la/ /ye shes lnga dang phyag rgya dang / /sangs rgyas bdag nyid gzugs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor chos rnams kyis bstod ༄ pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum / /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dga' chen po/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /rdo rje ston la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dri ma med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mtha' yas chags pa che/ /rnam par mi rtog rdo rje mkha'/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa thob—/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje don grub rdzogs sangs rgyas—/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzog sa pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /zla ba nyi ma chu sman dri/ /rlung me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /'od ldan phyag 'tshal byin gyis brlab/ /de nyid gsum gyi sngags btab nas/ /lce la rdo rje hūṃ bkod de/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gang bsgoms nas/ /snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil gnas kun/ /dkyil 'khor de yis tshim par bya/ /snying 'od sprul pa mgon po yis/ /dbus kyi kun rtog yongs spangs te/ /'gro ba sangs 23—263

rgyas nyid byas nas/ /ye shes sa bon dkyil du thim/ /snying ga'i phyag mtshan dkyil gnas pa/ /zla ba'i snying po thig le gzugs/ /'od gsal rang gi yid bsgoms te/ /ye shes sems dpa' gsal bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yang / /'od zer 'phros pas gsal byed de/ /de yang snying la bzhugs bsams nas/ /de ni ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /de nas lus kyi nang kun du/ /de yis kun du gsal byas te/ /so so ba sru'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i don ni rdzogs par bya/ /rang gi phyag mtshan phra mo la/ /rang rig thub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'ong 'bar dam pa'i shes rab thogs/ /rig ma'i sna la gnas par bsgom/ /brtan pa'i mtshan ma mthong ma thag /de yi 'od zer 'phro ba ni/ /sangs rgyas sna tshogs phyag mtshan bsnams/ /yang dang yang du 'phro bar rtebasgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /'od zer lnga yi ye shes las/ /'phros nas sngags ni zlos byed pa/ /lhan cig yang na rim par bya/ /dbugs phyung 'phro ba spro byas te/ /dbugs bsdu sngags kyang bsdu bar bya/ /sku la sogs pa'i spro bsdu ba/ /rim pa rim par bzlas par bya/ /de ltar bzlas na nam mkha' la/ /sku sogs de dag rnams kyis khyab/ /sngon bzhin rang gi 'od zer mchod/ /dbugs phyung rig ma'i chu bo yis/ /gsang ba'i rig ma le lo yis/ /bde bar zhugs nas dbang gyur pa/ /ye shes sangs rgyas chu bo rnams/ /dgag pa'i dbugs kyis thim nas su/ /rang gi dkyil du thim par bya/ /rgyu mthun la sogs mos pa yis/ /thig le phra mo gsang gsum la/ /'bring po chung sogs phye nas su/ /spyor ba 2bsnyen sogs de bzhin no/ /rang snying de nyid mchog gzigs pa/ /sems la nyams su phyung gyur na/ /spyan sogs yon tan 23—264

dbyangs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsol nas mchod par bya/ /spyi bor zla ba phyag mtshan ldan/ /dam pa'i sems ni chu rgyun ni/ /'bab pa rim par byas nas su/ /sku gsung thugs la thim par bya/ /de ltar dbugs phyung bzlas nas su—/ /mkhas pas mchod pa la sogs bya/ /ci phyir de bzhin nyid gsum dag /thogs pa spangs nas rdzogs par bya/ /de 'dra de nyid dang bral ba'i/ /'gro ba thams cad mthong nas su/ /de dag phan phyir snying rje yis/ /smon lam kun du mngon par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas su/ /'gying bag gtso bo dang ldan nas/ /spyod pa sangs rgyas shes byas te/ /spyod yul rnams kyis rab tu mchod/ /'jam dpal rdo rje bdag nyid kun/ /rang bzhin las ni spyod yul 'gro/ /spyod yul de dag bsgom pa nyid/ /rang rang dag nas gnas phyir ro/ /rtag pa la sogs gnas pa'i phyir/ /so so rang rig chos su gnas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /sems dpa' dag pa dang ldan pas/ /dbugs kyi rtog pa spangs nas su/ /bya ba thams cad bya ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa mtha' yas 'di/ /rtag tu sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor gtso bo rgo/ /gzhi yi sa bon gyis bskyed la/ /rang gis bza' 1ba za dus na/ /rang snying de bzhin nyid dmigs dang / /bdud rtsis 5/sangs rgyas kun tshim bya/ /chos nyid kyi ni kun dag la/ /de nyid gsum kyi sngags btab nas/ /dkyil 'khor rang gi rig pa'i lha/ /de yis tshim par byas nas mchod/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg rjes dpags te//sems ni sems nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /bla na med pa 'di yin te/ /ye shes me ni 'bar byed nas/ /phung po'i bud shing bsregs pa'o/ /'dod pa 'di dag 23—265

thams cad ni/ /rang rang lha dag rang bzhin skye/ /de ltar bdag gzhan mchod byed pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dam tshig yin/ /gang zhig la ni de sku sogs/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod byed dang / /rjes su rig 27pa 'gro ba'i don / /rtag tu mnyam gzhag ༄ bsam gtan bya/ /gang zhig lus ngag dngos po las / /phyag rgya sngags kyi bdag nyid che/ /las de yang dag brtsams nas su / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /rnam rtog dngos po gcig pu la / /sna tshogs rnam par snang ba ste/ /sdug bsngal bde ba grol 'byung ba/ /ci phyir las ma lus pa yin/ /de phyir dge dang mi dge las/ /lus la sogs pa'i rtog pa 'byung / /kun rtog thams cad nges grol nas/ /ye shes rtogs par ga la 'gyur/ /don yod rdo rje dkyil 'khor gtsor/ /bsams nas dam tshig bslab don du/ /snying gar las kyi rdo rje khang / /bsams nas kun bdag dbang bskur bya/ /bla ma brnyas sogs skyon gyur na/ /yon dang bcas par ston mo dbul/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor la gnas te/ /bdag nyid la ni pha rol tu/ /rim pa gcig ni rnam bsams 5pa/ /snga ma'i gzugs ni gnas gyur nas/ /zhe sdang gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog lta bu/ /zhal gdangs mche ba gcigs pas 'jigs/ /mi 'khrugs 'bar ba spyi bor 'chang / /'jig rten khams kun 'khrugs par byed/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od/ /dmar ba'i spyan ni 'jigs pa che/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan/ /khro gnyer zhi ba 'dod chags che//zhal gsum dag ni rnam par 'chang / /rang gi dam tshig mnyam par ldan/ /phyag drug gis ni mngon par brgyan/ /'dzam bu na 7da'i 'od 'dra ba'i/ /23—266

sangs rgyas sprin gyis rnam 'khrigs pa'i/ /rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa/ /de yi phyag tu rnam par bsgom/ /sngar gsungs pa yi rim ṣ+ṭṛbazhin du/ /phyag rgya phyi ma rnam par bsgom/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer byin 3bhebarlabs nas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu spro/ /dzi na dzika /sa bon las ni bskyed bya ba/ /rnam par snang mdzad gtso bo ste/ /zhi ba'i cha lugs dag dang ldan/ /phyogs ni thams cad snang bar mdzad/ /ston ka'i 'dam bu'i 'od 'dra ba/ /ral pa'i cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /mi 'khrugs pas ni dbang bskur zhing / /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun kyis brgyan/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar chen po/ /kha dog gsum pa zhal gsum pa/ /'od zer sna tshogs chen pos brgyan/ /phyag drug rnam par bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu rnam par bsam/ /dril bu nor bu ral gri rnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag tu rnam par bsgom/ /snying las de bzhin byung nas ni/ /phyogs kun du ni rnam par gzigs—/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul mdzad la sogs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /gti mug lam la rab gnas pa'i/ /sems can ma lus sbyangs nas ni/ /slar log mdun gyi phyogs dag na/ /zla ba'i dbus su rnam par gnas—/ /rat+na be+eka /sa bon las ni skyes pa yi/ /dkon mchog dpal ni mkhas pas bskyed/ /ral pa cod pan 'chang la zhi/ /mi 'khrugs dbang bskur bas ni brgyan/ /zhal gsum kha dog gsum pa ste/ /ser dang dmar dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /thams cad rgyan gudang rab ldan pa'i/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsgom par bya/ /dril bu ral gri pad+ma ser/ /g.yon pa dag tu rnam par bsgom/ /23—267

de bzhin snying ga nas byung nas/ /'jig rten khams ni rnam par gzigs/ /nga rgyal gnas la gnas pa yi/ /sems can thams cad sbyong bar mdzad/ /rin chen chen po slar gshegs nas/ /thams cad dbang bskur phun sum tshogs//rdo rje sems dpa'i g.yas phyogs kyi/ /rin chen dbus su rnam par bzhugs/ /a ro dzaka1 /sa bon dag las grub pa yis thu/ /rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas bskyed / /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /mi 'khrugs pas ni cod pan brgyan//zhi ba ral pa cod pan 'chang / /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /thams cad rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /phyag drug pa ni bsgom par bya/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas pad+ma 'dzin/ /dril bu dkur brten phan phyir te/ /g.yas par pad+ma skyod mdzad cing / /thugs kar pad+ma kha yang 'byed/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /g.yon gnyis rin chen ral gri bsnams/ /snying ga nas ni byung gyur nas/ /thams cad phyogs su rnam par gzigs/ /sems can 'dod chags ldan sbyong ste/ /'dam can chu yi pad+ma bzhin/ /be+er gshegs pad+ma'i dbus su ni/ /rgyab kyi phyogs su mngon par bzhugs/ /pradz+nyā j-ika /sa bon las ni grub pa yi/ /rdo rje gdon mi za ba bskyed/ /ljang gu bai ḍūr+ya 'dra ba/ /ral pa cod pan rdo rje gnas/ /thams cad rgyan kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ljang gu gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /'od zer rnam lnga 'khrigs /par 'bar/ /phyag drug rnam par bsam par bya/ /ral gri rdo rje rgya gram dang / /'khor lo g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsgom/ /dril bu pad+ma'i sdong bcas dang / /nor bu g.yon pa'i phyag tu bsam/ /de bzhin snyeng ga nas byung nas/ /phyogs bcu kun du gzigs mdzad de/ /brdzun tshig smra ba'i lam gnas pa'i/ /23—268

sems can thams cad kun du spyod/ /sna tshogs chen po slar gshegs nas/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems kyi byang phyogs su/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig ste/ /rigs lngar gtogs pa 'di rnams kyis/ /'dod dang grol bar rab grub pa'o/ / dwo ṣa skyar ti/ gsang sngags las ni grub pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyi lha mo bskyed/ /sngo bsangs a la mdog 'dra ba//yid du 'ong ba rmyemadzes pa'i zhal/ /gnag dang dmar dang dkar 'dra ba'i/ /zhal gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /mi 'khrugs cod pan gnas byas pa'i/ /phyag drug pa ni bsgom par bya/ /rgyal mo rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin/ /sngo dmar at+pal phyag na bsnams/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas dril bu ste/ /rin chen ral gri rtag tu 'chang / /snying ga nas ni byung gyur nas/ /phyogs bcur rnam par gzigs mdzad de/ /bgegs chen gyis ni 'jigs rnams la/ /rtag tu srung ba nyid du mdzad/ /'bar ba slar yang gshegs nas ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus ma yin/ /lho yi grwar ni bzhugs nas kyang / /rab dgyes rdo rje la yang gzigs—/ /mo ha ra ti/ gsang sngags las ni grub pa yi/ /spyan gyi lha mo bskyed par bya/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /rnam par snang mdzad spyi bor gnas/ /me tog sna tshogs tshad med pas/ /dbu la thod du rnam par bcings / /dkar dang gnag dang dmar chen po'i/ /zhal gsum pa ni rab tu 'bar/ /cha lugs brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ /'od zer dkar pos kun du 'khrigs—/ /rgyan rnams kun dang ldan pa yi/④/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam par bsam—/ /rgyal mo 'khor lo rdo rje 'dzin/ /at+pal dkar po phyag na bsnams/ /23—269

rin chen sdong bu g.yon na ste/ /dril bu ral gri 'dzin pa'i mchog /de bzhin snying ga nas byung nas/ /phyogs bcu dag tu rnam par gzigs/ /gdon nad na ba'i sems can dag /zhi ba'i gnas kyis zhi bar mdzad/ /snang mdzad de ni slar gshegs nas/ /dad pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /shar gyi grwar ni bzhugs 3nas kyang / /rdo rje mgon la gzigs par mdzad/ /rā ga zhe ra ti/gsang sngags las ni grub pa yi/ /gos dkar mo ni bskyed par bya/ /zhal mdzes spyan ni ring ba ste/ /pad+ma rā ga zla mdog 'dra/ /zhal gsum dag ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba ste/ /snang ba mtha' yas cod pan gnas/ /thams cad rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sgyu 'phrul mtshon las kun du 'byung / /'dod chags dmar po 'chad la dga'/ /mtshan rnams thams cad kun rdzogs pa'i/ /phyag drug rnam par bsgom par bya/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas dril bu dang / /sdong bu lor bcas aXl 'dzin/ /sgeg dang bcas pa'i g.yas pa yis/ /a la dmar po kha yang 'byed/ /gnyis ni rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu ral gri 'chang / /snying ga nas ni byung gyur nas/ /thams cad phyogs su rnam par gzigs/ /gza' sogs kyis skams sems can rnams/ /tshe dang mtshungs par rgyas par mdzad cho/ /slar gshegs pad+ma'i dbus su bzhugs/ /badz+ra ra ti/ gsang sngags las ni grub pa yi/ /lha mo sgrol ma mkhas pas bskyed/ /yan lag mtshan rnams kun dang ldan/ /bud med ma rungs myos mdzad brtson/ /mdzes pa'i zhal ni spyan ring ba/ /margad 5ser po'i mdog kyang 'dra/ /gdon mi za mchog cod pan mdzes6 / /me tog phreng gi cod pan dkris/ /ljang gu nag dz+wadang dkar 'dra 23—270

ba'i—/ /zhal gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kun rdzogs pa'i/ /phyag drug pa ni bsam par bya/ /rdo rje rgya gram 'khor lo 'dzin/ /at+pal ser po phyag na bsnams/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas dril bu ste/ /rin chen ral gris phyag ni brgyan/ /snying ga nas ni byung gyur nas/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gis rmongs pa'i/ /sems can dbang du byed pa ni/ /'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis tesna/ /sems ni med dzoltar dbang gyur nas/ /thams cad mngon par phyogs par gnas/ /slar gshegs dam tshig dbus su ni/ /byang gi phyogs kyi grwar ni bzhugasazhe / /gsang sngags yi ge las grub pa'i/ /mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa' bskyed/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur ba'i/ /kha dog gsum dag zhal gsum pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /so so'i rigs bzhin kha dog brgya/ /de dag thams cad bsgom par bya/ /sgrol ma'i phyag rgyar gsungs pa ni/ /kun du bzang po 4bsgom par bya/ /at+pal yongs su bsal nas ni/ /pad+ma de la sbyin par bya/ /byams pa klu shing me tog ste/ /lhag ma rnam snang mdzad kyi gnas5 / /'jam dpal dril bu ral gri mchog /de bzhin du ni rab tu gnas/ /lag pa g.yon pa sa la gnon/ /g.yas pa zhu ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /lhag ma kun du bzang po yi/ /phyag rgya de ni rnam par bsgom/ /shar gyi ngos la gnyis 6nyid de/ /sa yi snying po byams pa gnas/ /lhor ni phyag na rdo rje dang / /nam mkha' zhes bstan kun du gnas/ /nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rnam par gnas/ /byang du sgrib sel bstan pa dang / /kun du bzang po rab tu grags/ /'di ltar 'di yi dam gsungs pa/ /gzugs kyi rdo 23—27/

rje la sogs lha/ /'di dang thabs cig bzhugs pa ni/ /lag gnyis rang rtags ldan par gzhag1 /gzugs ni lag gnyis me long 'dzin/ /sgra ni lag gnyis pi wang ngo / /dri ni lag gnyis dung phor te/ /ro ni lag gnyis snod gnas so/ /reg ni rdo rje yongs 'khyud ma/ /snying ga dag tu yongs su 'khyud/ /rdo rje rgya gram dam tshig gis/ /bde bar gnas pa chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam snang mdzad sogs kha dog dang / /mtshon cha dag ni sna tshogs te/ /gzugs la sogs pa rnam bsgom pa/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i rim bzhin no/ /rnam par sel dang byams gnyis kyi2/ /kha dog mtshon cha ji bzhin gnas/ /dam tshig gnyis ni bsgom bya ba/ /byams pa snying rje zhes bya gnyis/ /ya mān+ta kṛta/ye shes las ni grub pa yi / /rdo rje zhabs drug bskyed par bya/ /sprin sngo lta bu'i kha dog la/ /gsus po che la stobs po che/ /'od zer stug po dag gis 'bar / /kun du khros pa'i 'jigs dang bcas/ /spyan dmar zhal gdangs mche ba gatshigs/ /zhal gsum dag ni rnam par bskyod/ /'bar ba'i dbu ni gyen du bcings/ /rtag par cod pan gnas byas te/ /yan lag rgyan kyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /phyag drug rnam par bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo ral gri bsnyems pas 'dzin/ /gtun shing mngon par bstod pa'i phyag /g.yon pa 'gying bas dril bu mchog /dgra sta zhags pa bsdigs par bcas/ /snying ga nas ni byung gyur pa/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /g.yas brkyang gnon pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /shar phyogs kyi ni sgor gnas so/ /pradz+nyādha kṛta/ ye shes las ni grub pa yi/ /rdo rje gzhan kyis mi thub bskyed/ /'od zer 'phro ba gdug 'bar zhing / /sbrul rnams kyis ni yan lag brgyan/ /'arbar ba'i dbu ni 23—272

brtan par bcings/ /mi 'khrugs pas ni spyi bor brgyan/ /khro gnyer mdzad cing dmar ba'i spyan/ /zhal gsum dag ni rnam par gdangs/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra ba'i/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang bar gnas pa ste/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje be+e con phyag na bsgreng 1/ /ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul du gnas/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas dril bu 'dzin/ /dgra sta mdzub mo zhags pa 'chang / /de bzhin snying ga nas byung nas / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /lho yi sgo yi dbus su ni/ /'dod pa'i khro bo kun du gnas/ /pad+mān+ta kṛta/ ye shes las ni grub pa yi/ /rdo rje gnyis med bskyed par bya/ /'od zer stug po 'phro 'bar ba'i /ban+d+ra ka yi me tog 'dra/ /dbu skra 'bar bcings gyen du 'greng / /rdo rje snang bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyag drug pa ni 'jigs pa che/ /zhal ni khro gnyer mdzad pa ste/ /phyag na pad+ma bskyod pa che/ /ral gri gtun shing mtshon cha'i phyag /g.yas brkyang 'gying ba'i tshul du gnas/ /g.yon pa dgra sta zhags pa 'chang /khro bo snying ga nas byung nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /btul nas rang gi dkyil 'khor la/ /nub phyogs kyi ni sgo ru gnas/ /bibyān+ta ༄ kṛta/ye shes las ni grub pa yi/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa bskyed par bya/ /'od zer snyug po 'bar ba ni/ /kha dog zar ma'i me tog 'dra/ /'bar bas 'khrigs pa'i sgra can dang / /rdo rje don grub cod pan can/ /zhal gsum khro gnyer rab bskyod cing / /mche ba rno can ha har bzhad/ /rdo rje rgya gram ral gri mtshon / /phyag na gtun shing gsod par gnas/ /dril bu dgra sta ral gri dang / /g.yon pa'i phyag tu rnam par brtag /de bzhin snying ga nas byung 23—273

nas / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /khro bo zhabs g.yas brkyang ba yis / /byang gi sgo yi dbus su gnas/ /khro bo'i dam tshig gsungs pa ni/ /ro langs gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /khro gnyer ral pa gcig ma ste/ /lha mo 'di bzhi rab tu grags/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyam sbyor ba/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung spyor ba ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gsungs/ /khro mo g.yon brkyang dag tu'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bskyed pa thurnams/ /thams cad dam tshig bzhis rgyas gdab/ /de ltar sbyor bas mnyam bsdus nas/ /phra mo'i spyor ba brtsam par bya/ /sna rtser yungs kar bsams nas ni/ /yungs kar de ni spro zhing bsnyu/ /tshad med ye shes gnas bsgom pa'i/ /gsang ba'i ye shes brtags pa'o/ /kha dog lnga pa'i rin po che/ /yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam dag /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom//brtan par gyur nas rin chen spro/ /brtan par ma gyur spro mi bya/ /sangs rgyas 'od 'bar lta bu yi/ /sprin gyi mchog ni spro bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo sprin chen po/ /pad+ma mdzod ni mtshon cha 'dzin/ /byang chub sems dpa' sprin chen po / /spro ba'i bdag nyid spro bar bya/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba'i/ /rtse mo lnga pa khyad par du/ /nas kyi tshad tsam nan tan kyis/ /sna yi rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /'khor lo la sogs bye brag gis / /de ltar bsgoms pas brtags pa ste/ /byang chub tshad med 'grub 'gyur zhing / /yon tan gnas rnams thams cad 'grub/ /mdor na de ltar bskyed byas na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu gnas/ /chos kyi gnas ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /lus dang ngag yid mtshon pa'o/ /de nas spro bar bya ba ni/ /rdo rje bye ba grangs med de/ /23—274

til gong bzhin du mkha' dgang la/ /rdo rje bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /bzlas mthar sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms te/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i spyor bas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snyebyin gyis rlob/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'byung ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje gsang sngags byin rlabs zhe kyis/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes 'thob/ /gsang sngags don kun bzlas pa ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyis mtshan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum rdzogs pa/ /'di dmigs rdo rje gsum zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje ye shes bsgoms nas ni/ /mchod pa'i mchog ni rtag byas na/ /'dis ni byang chub mtshungs par 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs ni mngon sum du/ /cho ga gsum gyis spro bar bya/ /bzlas pa rdo rje 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sems 'drar 'gyur/ /yang na spro bar spre bya ba ni/ /so sor gsum gyi bye brag gis/ /sku gsung thugs ni bdag med par/ /ye shes sems kyis 4spro bar bya/ /khro bo'i dam tshig ye shes kyis/ /rang gi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /de ni khro bo'i bzlas pa yin5/ /bzlas pa rdo rje kun du spro/ /rdzogs nas rab tu basbu bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis6/ /bzlas par gsungs pa don dam pa'o/ /chos dang phyag rgya glur blangs pa/ /rdo rje tshig tu spyor ba ste/ /'di ni gsal ba gsang ba'i tshig /rdo rje'i tshig ni skad gdangs med/ /hūṃ badz+ra dh+rika /gsum pa spros pa bsdus nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub par bya/ /gal te rgyal po ma grub na/ /drag shul sbyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje chen pos bsgrub par bya/ /cho ga bzhin du rtag bsgoms te/ /snying ga dag tu brdeg 7pa 23—275

yis / /ye shes sems dpa' rab tu bskul/ /yang na rang gi dam tshig khro/ /lus dang ngag sems las byung ba/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na lcags kyu dang / /g.yas pa na ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gal te me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /stobs chen de ni gtang 1bar bya/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gnas pa de/ /khro bos snying gar brdeg bya zhing / /khro bo'i tshig gis bskul bar bya/ /che ge zhes bya rdo rje che/ /khyod ni sgrub 2par gnas pa ste/ /'di ltar rtag tu khyod la gus/ /de ni dam tshig srung ba'i mchog /dbang bskur rjes su gnang ba ste/ /de la dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /'di ni rdo rje tshul mchog ste/ /zhag bdun bar du byas na ni/ /lus ngag yid ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dngos grub bo/ /'jigs shing skrag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mchog sbyin mgon po gzigs mdzad de/ /chog shes sems dang dga' bar ni/ /dngos grub chen po stsol bar mdzad/ /rdo rje gsum 'byung 'dra bar ni/ /'dis ni byang chub thob 'gyur te/ /rgyal ba byang chub rgya mtsho yi/ /rdo rje sems dpar de 'gyur ro/ /spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo dang / /bral ba'i cha lugs ji bzhin du/ /bde ba mchog la zhen pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par gzigs / /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs dag dang / /phra mo yi ni dbyangs la sogs/ /'dod pa bde ba zhi don gyis/ /bsgul ba dag 4tu rnam par bsam / /rdo rje sems khyod sa bdag ste/ /sems can khams ni skyed zhimadzad pa / /'dod dga' yid 'ong don chen te/ /sems can kun gnyen che mchog gis/ /gal te bdag srog bzhed pa na/ /mgon po bdag la 'dod pa spyod / /rdo rje sku khyod sangs rgyas 'khor lo don/ /sems can mang po dga' 23—276

ba rtogs mdzad cing / /byang chub dam pa'i don ni phan pa ston/ /dam tshig la ni 'dod pas 'dod chags pa/ /gal te mgon po bdag srog bzhed pa na/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa bdag la spyad du gsol/ /rdo rje gsung khyod thams cad kun la ni / /phan dang 'jig rten thugs brtse sems can don/ /dgos pa'i bya ba kun la rab tu chags/ /gal te mgon po bdag srog bzhed pa na/ /rab dgyes kun bzang 'dod pas bdag la spyod/ /rdo rje 'dod khyed dam tshig mchog lags te/ /phan pa'i don chen rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rigs/ /mnyam nyid thig le rjes su thugs brtser ldan/ /gal te mgon po bdag srog bzhed pa na/ /yon tan rin chen gter mang bdag la spyod/ /de ltar lha mos bskul nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs la stod 1par byed/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dga' chen po/ /rdo rje zhi ba dgyes pa che/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal chos/ /rdo rje ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dri rnged mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma me+ed/ /gsang ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal chen rdo rje snang mtha' yas/ /rnam par mi rtog rdo rje mkha'/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin brnyes pa'i/ /rdo rje gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje don grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par mdzad/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar bstod tshig zhi ba yis / /sangs rgyas thams cad bskul byas nas/ /rdo rje longs spyod kyis bstod na/ /de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ /lha mos de bzhin gshegs 23—277

bstod pa/ /rdo rje blo yis gzigs nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs la bsdus mdzad nas / /sna tshogs rjes su chags par mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje be+e/ /cho ga bzhin du brtan byas nas//bzlas pa dag ni bsdu bar bya/ /ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pa na/ /sngags pa lus nyam chung gyur na/ /lus ngag yid ni brtan (bya'i phyir/ /sbyor ba 'di ni brtsam par bya/ /spyi bor dkyil 'khor brtag pa ni/ /mtho gang gi ni tshad tsam ste/ /oṃ ni dbus su bsgoms nas kyang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'gyur snyebar bsam / /rdo rje spyor ba 'di yis ni/ /skad cig gis ni mdangs ldan 'gyur//lus dang ngag sems bde gnas pa/ /the tshom med par 'grub pa yin/ /bkres skom la sogs sbug bsngal la/ /spyor ba 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med 'gyur ba/ /mi gtsang rdo rje tshig bzhin te/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs chen po/ /bsgoms pas don kun phun sum tshogs/ /ba ni kha la bsgom byas nas/ /oṃ zhes pa ni lce la dmigs/ /bza' ba kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /sdug bsngal kun sel rab zhi ba/ /ye shes rdo rje byin brlab ste/ /gang zhig 'di ni sgom byed pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ldan na/ /sku gsung dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dad pa med dang theg dman zhugs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang dbang rtul na/ /slob bu la yang sbyin mi bya/ /gang phyir sgrub 4pa 'di brtsams pa/ /rgyud don mngon par rtogs nas ni/ /rdo rje sems bsgrub phyir bris te/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /sems can ye shes bskyed phyir ro/ /dpal bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //523—278

༄ga /dpal bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā su kha sā dha na 2pi ka bya khya na/bod skad du/ dpal bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /ye shes mtha' yas 'byung gnas la / /phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs don rnams ni/ /bla mas bstan bzhin bdag gis bri/ /dpal zhes bya ba ni phun sum tshogs pa la bya'o / /de yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi dpal ni lha dang mi'i 'byor pa thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad la bya'o/ /de gnyis dang ldan pas dpal ldan zhes bya'o/ /dpal gyi sgras ni lha mo bzhi la sogs pa la yang bya ste / de rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i tshul du gnas pas dpal ldan no / /rdo rje ni yang dag pa'i ye shes sems dpa' ni de nyid kyi rang bzhin yin 23—281

pas sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ sems can thams cad dang mthun par sku bstan pas sems dpa'o/ /mgon po sangs rgyas kun ngo bo/ /zhes pa ni thugs rje'i rang bzhin yin pas sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun par thams cad kyi don mdzad pas mgon po zhes bya/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid yin pas so/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rgyal ba'i gtso/ /zhes pa ni sems can zhe sdang can thams cad 'dul ba'i cha lugs su bstan pas zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi mchog tu gyur pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yin pas na rgyalaba'i gtso/ lha mo zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul du bde ba chen po rtag tu nyams su myong ba la bya'o/ /dad pas zhes pa ni gus pa dang bcas pas so/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal nas/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i don ni rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa 'di gang zag blo dman pa rnams kyis rtogs shing go dka' bas de lta bu'i sems can rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal ni badz+ra satwa/de dang ldan pas dpal ldan no/ /gsang 'dus ni rgyud kyi mtshan no/ /don ni nges pa'o/ /rtogs 71pa ni sems kyis so/ /gsang ba ni tshig gis so/ /sems can 2ni khams gsum na gnas pa'o/ /phan pa ni mtho ris dang thar pa thob par bya ba rgyud 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir sgrub pa'o//de yang gang zhe na/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'o/ /thabs ni yan lag go/ /'di ni brtsams pa'i dngos po'o/ /bshad par bya zhes pa ni dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po sems bskyed ma thag go/ /sngags pa zhes bya ba ni 23—282

gsang sngags kyi tshul la spyod pa'o/ /nges pa ni the tshom med pa'o/ /da ni 'jug pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin te/ rdo rje ni ky-iyang dag pa'i don te de la ma nor bar ston cing bde ba chen po'i go 'phang thob par byed pa'o/ /mnyes par bya ba yang rnam pa zugasum ste phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /phyi ni lus dang longs spyod do/ /nang ni shes rab rnam gsum gyi sgo nas so/ /gsang ba ni gsang ba'i mchod pas so/ /de ltar slob dpon mnyes par byas nas dbang rnam gsum thob nas gnang ba ni sgrubs shig ces bya ba'i don to/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni mnyes par bya ba la sogs pa zin nas so/ /sgrub pa ni gang yang rung ba'i sgrub pa'i dngos po'o/ /brtsam par bya ba ni 'jug pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi don ni sgra las drangs na maṇ+ḍa ni snying po'o/ /la ni a da na 1ste len pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor pas dkyil 'khor ro/ /der zhugs pa ni tshul bzhin du slob dbon gyis bstan zhing dbang bskur ba'o/ /de bzhin ni 'dra ba'i don gsang ba ni thun mong ma yin pa dang / rtog ge pas ma yin pa'o/ /nyid ni ma nor ba dkyil 'khor gyi don dang gnyis su med pa'i don to/ /shes pa ni go ba'o/ /kun byed thams cad za ba yis/ /zhes pa ni rtog pa med cing gnyis su med pa'i spyod pa'o/ /the tshom med par dngos grub thob/ /ces bya ba ni yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pas bsgrubs na yid kyi 'dod pa'i don grub ces bya ba'i don to/ /gtso bo ni yi dam gyi 4lha dang rdo rje slob dpon gnyis so/ /mi phyed pa ni mi 'gyur ba dang rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /dad pa ni yid ches pa dang gus pa dang chags pa'o/ /rnam pa ni tha dad pa mi rtog pa'i blo ni tha dad pa'i 'du shes med cing gnyis su med pa'o/ /dam tshig ni mi 'da' ba ste sku gsung thugs la sogs 23—283

pa'o / /sdom pa ni mi g.yeng ba'o/ /gnas pa ni ldan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas bsgrubs na sku gsung thugs kyi 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bram ze zhes bya ba ni dge ba'i ngang nyid yin pas na 1dor ba'i tshig go/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni dman pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don ni gong du bstan pa'i yon tan dang mi ldan par rang bzo ༄ dang gzu lums su byas shing bsgrubs na/ 'bras bu mi 'thob cing byas pa chud zos pas byar mi rung bar bstan / de lta bas na dam tshig dang sdom pa bstan te/ dam tshig ni bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas so/ /sdom pa ni kha na ma tho ba med par dang du len pa'o/ /de yang gang yin zhe na/ sha la sogs pa bdud rtsi lnga'o/ /sha ni sha chen/ rak+ta ni khrag thams cad/ dri chen dang rdo rje chu yang kun gyi'o/ /sems ni lnga pa byang chub byung ba zhes pa ni thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rol pa las byung ba yin pas so/ /sngags pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa sgrub 4pa/ cho gas zhes pa ni bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa dang 'gro 5nas 'byung ba'i thabs so/ /nyin gcig bzhin du ni dus thams cad du'o/ /sbyang ba ni hūṃ gis so/ /'bar ba ni oṃ gyis so/ /rtogs pa ni āḥyis 6so/ /dogs pa ni 'grub mi 'grub pa'i the tshom mo/ /med pa ni spangs pa'i sems so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa ci ltar gshegs pa bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de yang gang zhe na thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshul bsgoms shing 9bsgrubs pas bde ba chen po'i ngang du gyur pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o/ /mnyes pa ni dgyes pa'i don to/ /de yang mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /de 23—284
